literature.headline_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期人乳头瘤病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 结果 人乳头瘤病毒 16 E6 和 E7 癌蛋白降解 p53 和视网膜母细胞瘤蛋白,调节磷酸肌醇 3 激酶、蛋白激酶 B 和雷帕霉素信号传导的机制靶标,并导致基因组不稳定。 [10.1017/s0022215126106124]
吡唑啉弹 EN218 被鉴定为带有氯乙酰胺半胱氨酸反应弹头。进一步的评估导致了 (S)-WX48A 的开发,它与 E6 上的 C58 发生立体选择性反应,抑制 E6 介导的 p53 泛素化。 [10.1002/cbic.70590]
总共纳入了 25 项报告定性或混合方法的研究。综合结果从女性的角度产生了三个主题:女性对 HPV 自我采样的看法、女性对卫生专业人员 HPV 采样的经验以及女性对社区 HPV 采样的看法。女性对自我取样的接受程度很高,因为她们有对自己身体的控制感、手术过程的舒适感和节省时间的好处。 [10.1111/phn.70203]
≥20/10 HPF 时 TBA 增加与整个 队列研究 ( P = 0.002) 和 HPV 独立/p53 异常 vSCC ( P = 0.003) 较短的无复发生存期 (RFS) 相关。在调整肿瘤亚型、LVI、T 和 N 类别后,TBA 还与较短的疾病特异性生存期和总生存期相关(分别为 P = 0.048 和 P = 0.009)。 [10.1097/pas.0000000000002644]
细胞周期分析表明,E2 灶在 S 期形成并持续进入 G2 期。E8^E2 表达或抑制活性的丧失增加了复制灶的数量并诱导弥漫性核 E2 染色。在器官型培养物中,在基底上层中先检测到 E2 灶阳性/E4 阴性细胞,然后再检测到 E2 灶阳性/E4 阳性细胞。 [10.1128/jvi.01408-26]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Results Human papillomavirus 16 E6 and E7 oncoproteins degrade p53 and retinoblastoma protein, dysregulate phosphoinositide 3 kinase, protein kinase B and mechanistic target of rapamycin signalling and drive genomic instability. [10.1017/s0022215126106124]

A pyrazoline hit, EN218, was identified with a chloroacetamide cysteine-reactive warhead. Further evaluation led to the development of (S)-WX48A, which stereoselectively reacted with C58 on E6 to inhibit E6-mediated p53 ubiquitination. [10.1002/cbic.70590]

A total of 25 studies reporting qualitative or mixed methods were included. The synthesis resulted in three themes generated from the women's perspective: Women's perceptions of HPV self‐sampling, Women's experiences of health professionals’ HPV sampling, and Women's perceptions of community HPV sampling. [10.1111/phn.70203]

Increased TBA at ≥20/10 HPF was associated with shorter recurrence-free survival (RFS) in the entire cohort ( P =0.002) and HPV-independent/p53-abnormal vSCCs ( P =0.003). [10.1097/pas.0000000000002644]

Cell-cycle analysis showed that E2 foci formed during the S phase and persisted into the G2 phase. Loss of E8^E2 expression or repression activity increased the number of replication foci and induced diffuse nuclear E2 staining. [10.1128/jvi.01408-26]

news.lead_zh: 本期人乳头瘤病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 所提供的证据没有用经过验证的英语清楚地报告中心事件。 [news-6841769b78195c4c]
《分子生物科学前沿》上发表的一篇新综述探讨了 HPV 引起的 宫颈癌 细胞中 O-GlcNAcylation 的作用,重点关注其与代谢重编程和肿瘤生物学的潜在联系。 [news-1f79d369d2cffc61]
CoSara SARAGENE 高危型HPV 测试用于 宫颈癌 筛选研究。这是科学发展,而不是 暴发 或健康事件。 [news-4c52cc251dd0adbc]
据比利时医学生 Anais Hublet 和当地护士兼助产士 Shida Gomeka(N3、N12)报道,卡龙加区通过在现有筛查服务的同时引入 HPV 疫苗接种 来扩大 宫颈癌 预防工作。 [news-030d2322e9b12a3f]
文章强调,宫颈癌 的预防需要的不仅仅是 HPV 疫苗接种,包括每两年定期筛查,因为早期发现至关重要,而且在疾病进展过程中往往没有症状。 [news-0dd31081c9a222f7]

news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Human papillomaviruses news developments.
key_findings_en: The supplied evidence does not clearly report the central event in verified English. [news-6841769b78195c4c]

A new review published in Frontiers in Molecular Biosciences explores the role of O-GlcNAcylation in cervical cancer cells caused by HPV, focusing on its potential connection to metabolic reprogramming and tumor biology. [news-1f79d369d2cffc61]
The CoSara SARAGENE high-risk HPV test was used in a cervical cancer screening study. This is a scientific development and not an outbreak or health event. [news-4c52cc251dd0adbc]

Karonga District expanded its cervical cancer prevention efforts by introducing HPV vaccination alongside existing screening services, as reported by Belgian medical student Anais Hublet and local nurse-midwife Shida Gomeka (N3, N12). [news-030d2322e9b12a3f]

The article emphasizes that cervical cancer prevention requires more than HPV vaccination, including regular screening every two years, as early detection is critical and symptoms are often absent during the progression of the disease. [news-0dd31081c9a222f7]

papers.title: The role of human papillomavirus in the pathogenesis of oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma and the impact of vaccination on disease prevention: a narrative review
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma accounts for over a third of head and neck cancers, with the cost of treatment in the UK reaching £14.3 billion over 15 years. Human papillomavirus (HPV) has surpassed smoking and alcohol as the leading aetiological driver. This review examines HPV pathogenesis and the impact of vaccination on disease prevention. Methods PubMed, Embase and Medline were searched for articles published to December 2025, combining terms including oropharyngeal, squamous cell carcinoma, HPV, vaccines, pathogenesis and phosphoinositide 3 kinase. Gynaecological HPV malignancies were excluded, and reference lists were hand-searched. Results Human papillomavirus 16 E6 and E7 oncoproteins degrade p53 and retinoblastoma protein, dysregulate phosphoinositide 3 kinase, protein kinase B and mechanistic target of rapamycin signalling and drive genomic instability. p16 is a useful but imperfect surrogate biomarker. Vaccination reduces oral HPV prevalence and is projected to lower incidence, although uptake remains suboptimal among males and in deprived areas. Conclusion Gender-neutral vaccination, improved uptake and the development of therapeutic vaccines and phosphoinositide 3 kinase-targeted therapies offer realistic strategies to reduce disease burden.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 方法 检索 PubMed、Embase 和 Medline 发表至 2025 年 12 月的文章,结合术语包括口咽癌、鳞状细胞癌、HPV、疫苗、发病机制 和磷酸肌醇 3 激酶。

elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: p16 是一种有用但不完善的替代生物标志物。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 疫苗接种 可以降低口腔 HPV 患病率,并且预计会降低 发病率,尽管男性和贫困地区的吸收率仍然不理想。

papers.title: Recurrence Rate of Genital Warts Between Treatment With Imiquimod and Polyphenon E: A Systematic Review.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Genital warts, a frequent manifestation of human papillomavirus, are commonly treated with Imiquimod 5% or Polyphenon E (10% or 15%), which differ in recurrence rates. This systematic review aimed to investigate the recurrence rates of genital warts following treatment with these agents. METHODS: This study systematically reviewed clinical trials according to PRISMA guidelines. A comprehensive search was performed in the electronic databases PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase up to the end of March 2025 using the keywords "genital warts," "recurrence," "Imiquimod," and "Polyphenon E," combined with the Boolean operators "AND" and "OR." Two reviewers independently assessed the methodological quality of included trials using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) critical appraisal tool (2023). RESULTS: Of the 605 studies identified in the initial search, 12 met the inclusion criteria for this systematic review. Based on the tabulated data, in the Imiquimod 5% studies, recurrence estimates ranged from 0% to 28.6%; most studies reported 12.5%-19%, and the 41% estimate was from the only study with 12-month follow-up. In the Polyphenon E studies, the ranges were 4.1%-11.8% for the 10% dose and 6.5%-10.6% for the 15% dose. CONCLUSIONS: Reported recurrence rates varied across studies of imiquimod 5% and Polyphenon E (10% or 15%). Because the evidence was indirect and heterogeneous, no comparative conclusion can be drawn; head-to-head trials are needed.
papers.journal: Journal of lower genital tract disease

papers.abstract_original: OBJECTIVES: Genital warts, a frequent manifestation of human papillomavirus, are commonly treated with Imiquimod 5% or Polyphenon E (10% or 15%), which differ in recurrence rates. This systematic review aimed to investigate the recurrence rates of genital warts following treatment with these agents. METHODS: This study systematically reviewed clinical trials according to PRISMA guidelines. A comprehensive search was performed in the electronic databases PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase up to the end of March 2025 using the keywords "genital warts," "recurrence," "Imiquimod," and "Polyphenon E," combined with the Boolean operators "AND" and "OR." Two reviewers independently assessed the methodological quality of included trials using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) critical appraisal tool (2023). RESULTS: Of the 605 studies identified in the initial search, 12 met the inclusion criteria for this systematic review. Based on the tabulated data, in the Imiquimod 5% studies, recurrence estimates ranged from 0% to 28.6%; most studies reported 12.5%-19%, and the 41% estimate was from the only study with 12-month follow-up. In the Polyphenon E studies, the ranges were 4.1%-11.8% for the 10% dose and 6.5%-10.6% for the 15% dose. CONCLUSIONS: Reported recurrence rates varied across studies of imiquimod 5% and Polyphenon E (10% or 15%). Because the evidence was indirect and heterogeneous, no comparative conclusion can be drawn; head-to-head trials are needed.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review examines the recurrence rates of genital warts after treatment with Imiquimod 5% or Polyphenon E (10% or 15%). The study searched PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase up to March 2025, identifying 605 studies, of which 12 met inclusion criteria. Recurrence estimates for Imiquimod 5% ranged from 0% to 28.6%, with most studies reporting 12.5%-19%, and a single study with 12-month follow-up reporting 41%. For Polyphenon E, recurrence rates ranged from 4.1%-11.8% for the 10% dose and 6.5%-10.6% for the 15% dose. The evidence was heterogeneous and indirect, preventing comparative conclusions. The review highlights the need for head-to-head trials to better understand the efficacy of these treatments.

papers.title: Human Papillomavirus Genotypes Among Women With Invasive Cervical Cancer in Nigeria: A Scoping Review
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: Invasive cervical cancer (ICC) cases remain a major public health concern for women in Nigeria. The purpose of this scoping review is to assess the reporting of common human papillomavirus (HPV) genotypes found in ICC cases among Nigerian women. METHODS: We searched five databases, including Embase, Ovid Medline, Scopus, Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, and Google Scholar, to identify studies reporting HPV genotypes found in ICC cases in Nigeria. Study selection and data extraction were conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews guidelines. Two researchers extracted data from each eligible article. RESULTS: A total of 668 records were identified, of which 422 studies were screened and six articles met the eligibility criteria. The included studies reported on HPV genotypes detected in ICC among Nigerian women. Across the studies, high-risk HPV (hrHPV) types 16, 18, 35, and 45 were identified in approximately 50% of ICC cases, whereas other detected genotypes included hrHPV types 31, 33, 51, and 52. Notably, in addition to globally predominant hrHPV types 16 and 18, hrHPV types 35 and 45 were also frequently detected, indicating their significant contribution to the ICC burden among Nigerian women. CONCLUSION: After an extensive search, this study provides a comprehensive assessment of the overall prevalence and distribution of hrHPV genotypes in Nigerian women with ICC. The most common hrHPV genotypes detected in ICC in Nigeria are 16, 18, 35, 45, 31, 33, 51, and 52. hrHPV types 16 and 18 account for the majority of cases, but in Nigeria and among women of African descent worldwide, hrHPV types 45 and 35 are also significantly present in ICC cases.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:侵袭性 宫颈癌 (ICC) 病例仍然是尼日利亚妇女的主要公共卫生问题。本次范围审查的目的是评估尼日利亚妇女 ICC 病例中常见 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 基因型的报告。方法:我们检索了五个数据库,包括 Embase、Ovid Medline、Scopus、Cochrane 系统评价数据库和 Google Scholar,以确定报告尼日利亚 ICC 病例中发现的 HPV 基因型的研究。研究选择和数据提取是根据系统评价的首选报告项目和范围界定评价指南的荟萃分析扩展进行的。两名研究人员从每篇符合条件的文章中提取数据。结果:共鉴定出 668 条记录,筛选出 422 篇研究,6 篇文章符合入选标准。纳入的研究报告了 ICC 在尼日利亚妇女中检测到的 HPV 基因型。在所有研究中,大约 50% 的 ICC 病例中发现了 高危型HPV (hrHPV) 16、18、35 和 45 型,而其他检测到的基因型包括 hrHPV 31、33、51 和 52 型。值得注意的是,除了全球主要的 hrHPV 16 和 18 型外,hrHPV 35 和 45 型也经常被检测到,表明它们的基因型尼日利亚妇女的国际刑事法院负担做出了重大贡献。结论:经过广泛搜索,本研究对尼日利亚 ICC 女性的总体 患病率 和 hrHPV 基因型分布进行了全面评估。在尼日利亚 ICC 中检测到的最常见 hrHPV 基因型为 16、18、35、45、31、33、51 和 52。hrHPV 16 和 18 型占大多数病例,但在尼日利亚和世界各地的非洲裔女性中,hrHPV 45 和 35 型在 ICC 病例中也显着存在。

papers.title: Women's Experience of Human Papillomavirus Self‐Sampling in Cervical Cancer Screening Programs: A Scoping Review
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT This study aimed to map, identify, and synthesize women's experiences with human papillomavirus (HPV) self‐sampling in cervical cancer screening programs. The study was conducted as a scoping review, reported in accordance with PRISMA‐ScR. Studies involving women of all nationalities who had been offered HPV self‐sampling were included, of any qualitative study design, and published at any date in either English or a Scandinavian language. Systematic searches were conducted in the PubMed, CINAHL, PsycInfo, and EMBASE databases in May 2023, in September 2024, and in August 2025. Data were systematically charted by study characteristics, and the main findings were reported narratively. A total of 25 studies reporting qualitative or mixed methods were included. The synthesis resulted in three themes generated from the women's perspective: Women's perceptions of HPV self‐sampling , Women's experiences of health professionals’ HPV sampling , and Women's perceptions of community HPV sampling . Women experienced self‐sampling to be highly acceptable with feelings of control over their own bodies, comfort in the procedure, and time‐saving benefits. Some women experienced a lack of confidence in taking the sample themselves. The experience was influenced by the relationship with health professionals, for example, due to previous traumatic experiences, and by the women's immediate community, for example, relationships with other women or partners.

papers.title: Enablers and barriers to human papillomavirus vaccination implementation among key stakeholders in Ethiopia: A qualitative study
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination is an effective and lifesaving intervention against cervical cancer. However, achieving high, equitable, and sustainable uptake remains a significant challenge in low-resource settings, including Ethiopia. Therefore, this study aimed to explore the enablers and barriers to HPV vaccination implementation in Ethiopia. METHODS: An interpretive descriptive qualitative design was employed in purposively selected settings representing diverse socio-ecological contexts (Afar, Amhara, Addis Ababa, and Dire Dawa). Six focus group discussions were conducted with adolescent girls (n = 14), parents of eligible adolescent girls (n = 14), and community representatives (n = 14). In addition, nineteen key informant interviews (KIIs) were conducted with healthcare providers, Expanded Programme on Immunization (EPI) coordinators, and technical advisors from governmental and non-governmental organizations. Data were analysed using a combined deductive-inductive content analysis guided by the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR 2.0). RESULTS: Multiple interacting factors influenced HPV vaccination implementation in Ethiopia, categorised as enablers and barriers across community, health system, and policy levels. analysis.study_design_and_population: An interpretive descriptive qualitative design was used, involving six focus group discussions and 19 key informant interviews with diverse stakeholders, including adolescent girls, parents, community representatives, healthcare providers, and EPI coordinators, across four regions of Ethiopia.
analysis.methods: Data were collected through focus group discussions and key informant interviews and analysed using a combined deductive-inductive content analysis guided by the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR 2.0).
analysis.main_results: The study identified multiple enablers and barriers to HPV vaccination implementation, including supportive policies, community drivers, and health system readiness, as well as concerns about consent, misinformation, resource constraints, and equity gaps.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings by highlighting the complex interplay of factors at community, health system, and policy levels, emphasizing the need for tailored strategies to address these barriers and ensure long-term sustainability.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of targeted interventions to improve HPV vaccination coverage and equity, particularly in low-resource settings, by addressing community perceptions, health system constraints, and policy gaps.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's qualitative nature and reliance on self-reported data limit generalizability. The sample size and diversity of settings provide a rich understanding but may not fully represent all contexts in Ethiopia.

papers.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚主要利益相关者实施 人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗接种 的推动因素和障碍:定性研究
papers.source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination is an effective and lifesaving intervention against cervical cancer. However, achieving high, equitable, and sustainable uptake remains a significant challenge in low-resource settings, including Ethiopia. Therefore, this study aimed to explore the enablers and barriers to HPV vaccination implementation in Ethiopia. METHODS: An interpretive descriptive qualitative design was employed in purposively selected settings representing diverse socio-ecological contexts (Afar, Amhara, Addis Ababa, and Dire Dawa). Six focus group discussions were conducted with adolescent girls (n = 14), parents of eligible adolescent girls (n = 14), and community representatives (n = 14). In addition, nineteen key informant interviews (KIIs) were conducted with healthcare providers, Expanded Programme on Immunization (EPI) coordinators, and technical advisors from governmental and non-governmental organizations. Data were analysed using a combined deductive-inductive content analysis guided by the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR 2.0). RESULTS: Multiple interacting factors influenced HPV vaccination implementation in Ethiopia, categorised as enablers and barriers across community, health system, and policy levels. Enablers included the Perceived Vaccine Attributes and Delivery Adaptability, Supportive Policy and Multisectoral Strategic Partnerships, Socio-cultural and Belief-based Drivers, and Health System Readiness and Workforce Motivation. However, several barriers limited implementation, including Suspicions About Targeting 9-14-year-old Girls and Consent-related Administrative Obstacles, Pervasive Misinformation and Cognitive Resistance, Health System Resource Constraints and Coordination Gaps, Donor Dependency Risks and Financial Sustainability Concerns, and Structural Access Constraints and Equity Gaps. CONCLUSIONS: While policy shifts, external strategic partnerships, and frontline worker dedication have accelerated vaccine reach, the long-term sustainability of Ethiopia's HPV vaccination program remains constrained by multi-level barriers. Progress toward the global 2030 cervical cancer elimination targets requires trust-building risk-communication strategies to counter fertility myths, simplified consent procedures, targeted domestic resource mobilization, and context-specific delivery models tailored to underserved pastoralist and urban sub-populations.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗接种 是针对 宫颈癌 的有效且挽救生命的干预措施。然而,在包括埃塞俄比亚在内的资源匮乏地区,实现高、公平和可持续的吸收仍然是一项重大挑战。因此,本研究旨在探讨 HPV 疫苗接种 在埃塞俄比亚实施的推动因素和障碍。方法:在有目的地选择的代表不同社会生态背景的环境(阿法尔、阿姆哈拉、亚的斯亚贝巴和德雷达瓦)中采用解释性描述性定性设计。与青春期女孩(n = 14)、符合条件的青春期女孩的父母(n = 14)和社区代表(n = 14)进行了六次焦点小组讨论。此外,还与医疗保健提供者、扩大免疫计划 (EPI) 协调员以及来自政府和非政府组织的技术顾问进行了 19 次关键知情人访谈 (KII)。使用以实施研究综合框架 (CFIR 2.0) 为指导的组合演绎-归纳内容分析来分析数据。结果:多种相互作用的因素影响了 HPV 疫苗接种 在埃塞俄比亚的实施,这些因素被归类为社区、卫生系统和政策层面的推动因素和障碍。推动因素包括感知的 疫苗 属性和交付适应性、支持性政策和多部门战略伙伴关系、社会文化和基于信仰的驱动因素以及卫生系统准备情况和劳动力激励。然而,一些障碍限制了实施,包括对针对 9-14 岁女孩的怀疑和与同意相关的行政障碍、普遍存在的错误信息和认知阻力、卫生系统资源限制和协调差距、捐助者依赖风险和财务可持续性问题、以及结构性准入限制和公平差距。结论:虽然政策转变、外部战略伙伴关系和一线工作人员的奉献精神加速了 疫苗 的覆盖范围,但埃塞俄比亚 HPV 疫苗接种 计划的长期可持续性仍然受到多层次障碍的限制。要实现 2030 年全球 宫颈癌 消除目标,需要建立信任的风险沟通策略来反驳生育神话、简化同意程序、有针对性的国内资源调动以及针对服务不足的牧民和城市亚人群量身定制的具体实施模式。

papers.title: Tumor Budding Activity is an Independent Prognostic Factor of Recurrence in Human Papillomavirus-Independent p53-Abnormal Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Vulva
papers.abstract: Outcomes of vulvar squamous cell carcinoma (vSCC) are driven by human papillomavirus (HPV) and p53 status. As tumor budding activity (TBA) and tumor-stroma ratio (TSR) are prognostic in other carcinomas, we evaluated their significance in vSCCs. Tumors diagnosed from 1990 to 2022 were identified, and clinicopathologic data, TBA, and TSR were assessed. The cohort included 172 tumors: 73 (42.5%) HPV-associated, 74 (43%) HPV-independent/p53-abnormal, and 25 (14.5%) HPV-independent/p53-wild-type. Median patient age was 69.5 (22 to 98) years. Most tumors were staged as pT1b (132, 76.7%). Lymphovascular invasion (LVI) was present in 25 (14.5%), and lymph node metastases in 24.6% (33/134) of cases with nodal evaluation. The median TBA was 2 (0-45)/1 high-power field (HPF), 4 (0-198)/5 HPF, and 5 (0-304)/10 HPF. The median TSR was 60% (10% to 90%). Seventy (40.7%) patients experienced recurrences (median: 14 mo, 2-141). Increased TBA at ≥20/10 HPF was associated with shorter recurrence-free survival (RFS) in the entire cohort ( P =0.002) and HPV-independent/p53-abnormal vSCCs ( P =0.003). This association persisted in the HPV-independent/p53-abnormal vSCCs after adjusting for LVI, and T and N categories of pTNM stage ( P =0.012), and in the entire cohort after adjusting for tumor subtype and other covariates ( P =0.01). TBA was also associated with shorter disease-specific ( P =0.048) and overall ( P =0.009) survival after adjusting for tumor subtype, LVI, and T and N categories. Our study suggests that high TBA is associated with shorter recurrence-free survival in vSCC, particularly the HPV-independent/p53-abnormal subgroup, as well as with shorter disease-specific and overall survival after adjusting for tumor subtype, LVI, T and N categories. The findings warrant further validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估外阴鳞状细胞癌 (vSCC) 中肿瘤出芽活动 (TBA) 和肿瘤间质比 (TSR) 的重要性,因为 vSCC 的结果是由 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 和 p53 状态驱动的。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究纳入了 1990 年至 2022 年诊断的 172 个 vSCC 肿瘤,分为 HPV 相关亚组、HPV 独立/p53 异常亚组和 HPV 独立/p53 野生型亚组。队列研究 的患者中位年龄为 69.5 岁,大多数肿瘤分期为 pT1b。
elements_zh.methods: 对已识别肿瘤的临床病理学数据、TBA 和 TSR 进行评估。根据 HPV 状态和 p53 状态对肿瘤进行分类,并计算中位 TBA 和 TSR。
elements_zh.main_results: ≥20/10 HPF 时 TBA 增加与整个 队列研究 ( P = 0.002) 和 HPV 独立/p53 异常 vSCC ( P = 0.003) 较短的无复发生存期 (RFS) 相关。在调整肿瘤亚型、LVI、T 和 N 类别后,TBA 还与较短的疾病特异性生存期和总生存期相关(分别为 P = 0.048 和 P = 0.009)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,高 TBA 与 vSCC 较短的无复发生存期相关,特别是在 HPV 独立/p53 异常亚组中,并且在调整肿瘤亚型、LVI、T 和 N 类别后,与较短的疾病特异性生存期和总生存期相关。这些发现值得进一步验证。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,TBA 可能是预测 vSCC 复发和生存的有用生物标志物,特别是在 HPV 独立/p53 异常亚组中,并且可以为未来的研究和临床实践提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和缺乏随机性而受到限制。样本量适中,研究结果需要在更大规模的前瞻性研究中进一步验证。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估外阴鳞状细胞癌 (vSCC) 中肿瘤出芽活动 (TBA) 和肿瘤间质比 (TSR) 的重要性,因为 vSCC 的结果是由 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 和 p53 状态驱动的。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究纳入了 1990 年至 2022 年诊断的 172 个 vSCC 肿瘤,分为 HPV 相关亚组、HPV 独立/p53 异常亚组和 HPV 独立/p53 野生型亚组。队列研究 的患者中位年龄为 69.5 岁,大多数肿瘤分期为 pT1b。
analysis_zh.methods: 对已识别肿瘤的临床病理学数据、TBA 和 TSR 进行评估。根据 HPV 状态和 p53 状态对肿瘤进行分类,并计算中位 TBA 和 TSR。
analysis_zh.main_results: ≥20/10 HPF 时 TBA 增加与整个 队列研究 ( P = 0.002) 和 HPV 独立/p53 异常 vSCC ( P = 0.003) 较短的无复发生存期 (RFS) 相关。在调整肿瘤亚型、LVI、T 和 N 类别后,TBA 还与较短的疾病特异性生存期和总生存期相关(分别为 P = 0.048 和 P = 0.009)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,高 TBA 与 vSCC 较短的无复发生存期相关,特别是在 HPV 独立/p53 异常亚组中,并且在调整肿瘤亚型、LVI、T 和 N 类别后,与较短的疾病特异性生存期和总生存期相关。这些发现值得进一步验证。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,TBA 可能是预测 vSCC 复发和生存的有用生物标志物,特别是在 HPV 独立/p53 异常亚组中,并且可以为未来的研究和临床实践提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和缺乏随机性而受到限制。样本量适中,研究结果需要在更大规模的前瞻性研究中进一步验证。

papers.title: Percepción de los padres de familia sobre la vacuna para la prevención del Virus del Papiloma Humano (VPH), en el Barrio Concepción de María. Managua, Nicaragua, II semestre de 2025 Parents ́ perception regarding the vaccine for the prevention of the Human Papillomavirus (HPV) in the Concepción de María neighborhood, Managua, Nicaragua - second semester of 2025
papers.abstract: The research on parents' perceptions of the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine was conducted in the Concepción de María neighborhood of Managua during the second half of 2025. The study employed a quantitative, descriptive, and cross-sectional approach, surveying a population of approximately 3,010 residents. A convenience sample of 93 parents was selected. The results indicate that the predominant age group is between 31 and 35 years, with a higher participation rate among females and a secondary school education level. Regarding vaccination coverage, 82% of girls have been vaccinated against HPV, although 52% have only received the first dose. A positive perception of the vaccine, considered safe and effective, prevailed, while social or religious background did not show a significant influence on the decision to vaccinate. However, concerns persisted regarding potential side effects and existing myths about vaccination, including supposed infertility or early onset of sexual activity. Most parents recognized the importance of receiving adequate information about the vaccine and expressed interest in learning more about its effects, benefits, and administration schedule. The results reflect that education, and the dissemination of reliable scientific information are essential factors in reducing misconceptions, directly contributing to greater acceptance of the HPV vaccine.

papers.title: The Cancer Policy Lab Model: Strengthening Health Systems for Evidence-Informed Human Papillomavirus Vaccination Policy in Uganda
papers.abstract: PURPOSE To establish and implement the Cancer Policy Lab (CPL) model as a structured platform to strengthen national health system capacity for translating global evidence into actionable cancer control policy and practice in Uganda. METHODS The CPL Uganda (CPL-U), convened by the ANANDA Centre for Cancer Research (ACCR), brought together stakeholders across different levels of the health system, including policymakers, clinicians, researchers, civil society organizations, patient representatives, and implementing partners. The Lab applied a systems-oriented approach combining evidence synthesis, multi-sector dialogue, and structured group work across four domains: policy and governance; financing and sustainability; equity and access; and implementation and health systems. The Lab followed a four-step process: (1) defining a national policy question on human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination prioritization; (2) synthesizing global and local evidence, including vaccine effectiveness, cost-efficiency, and delivery strategies; (3) facilitating structured multi-sector deliberations to assess feasibility within the Ugandan health system; and (4) co-producing policy recommendations and drafting a policy brief for decision-makers. RESULTS The Lab generated actionable recommendations to optimize HPV vaccination in Uganda and produced the first CPL policy brief on HPV vaccination prioritization for national dissemination and policy engagement. Recommendations included maintaining the single-dose HPV vaccination strategy, prioritizing girls aged 9-14 years with catch-up vaccination up to 20 years, and institutionalizing regular policy review to align with emerging evidence. Financing recommendations emphasized strengthening domestic resource mobilization through dedicated Primary Health Care budget lines, increased government co-financing, and use of national cost-benefit analysis to guide investment decisions. Equity recommendations focused on targeted outreach to underserved populations, including out-of-school girls and vulnerable groups, alongside strengthened communication strategies to improve vaccine acceptance and demand. Implementation recommendations included integrating HPV vaccination delivery across service platforms, strengthening health worker training, improving supply chain systems, reinforcing multi-sector coordination, and enhancing data systems for accountable programme scale-up. CONCLUSION Structured, facilitated multi-sector engagement enhanced ownership, feasibility, and policy relevance of recommendations. The CPL demonstrates a practical and scalable model for linking global evidence to local policy and implementation while strengthening health systems. The model has strong potential for replication across cancer control priorities and other health policy challenges in diverse settings.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the Cancer Policy Lab Uganda (CPL-U), convened by the ANANDA Centre for Cancer Research (ACCR), which brought together stakeholders across different levels of the health system, including policymakers, clinicians, researchers, civil society organizations, patient representatives, and implementing partners. analysis.methods: The Lab applied a systems-oriented approach combining evidence synthesis, multi-sector dialogue, and structured group work across four domains: policy and governance; financing and sustainability; equity and access; and implementation and health systems. analysis.main_results: The Lab generated actionable recommendations to optimize HPV vaccination in Uganda and produced the first CPL policy brief on HPV vaccination prioritization for national dissemination and policy engagement. Financing recommendations emphasized strengthening domestic resource mobilization through dedicated Primary Health Care budget lines, increased government co-financing, and use of national cost-benefit analysis to guide investment decisions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating the effectiveness of structured, facilitated multi-sector engagement in enhancing ownership, feasibility, and policy relevance of recommendations. The model is novel in its approach to linking global evidence to local policy and implementation while strengthening health systems.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance, financing, and implementation strategies for HPV vaccination programs in Uganda, particularly in optimizing vaccine prioritization, improving equity and access, and strengthening health systems for sustainable policy adoption.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on stakeholder input and the absence of quantitative data on the impact of the recommendations. analysis.summary_en: This study describes the implementation of the Cancer Policy Lab (CPL) model in Uganda to strengthen health systems for evidence-informed human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination policy. It also emphasized strengthening domestic financing, improving equity through outreach to underserved populations, and enhancing implementation through multi-sector coordination and data systems. The authors concluded that structured multi-sector engagement improved the feasibility and relevance of policy recommendations. The study's findings have implications for improving HPV vaccination programs and health system capacity in Uganda, though the evidence is moderate due to the qualitative nature of the analysis and lack of direct outcome measurements.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在建立和实施癌症政策实验室(CPL)模型,作为一个结构化平台,以加强乌干达国家卫生系统将全球证据转化为可行的癌症控制政策和实践的能力。这一背景凸显了需要有证据支持的 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗接种 政策来解决 宫颈癌 和相关疾病。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究由 ANANDA 癌症研究中心 (ACCR) 召集的乌干达癌症政策实验室 (CPL-U) 参与,该实验室汇集了卫生系统不同层面的利益相关者,包括政策制定者、临床医生、研究人员、民间社会组织、患者代表和实施合作伙伴。该实验室专注于 HPV 疫苗接种 优先级及其在乌干达卫生系统内的实施。
elements_zh.methods: 该实验室采用了一种面向系统的方法,结合了证据合成、多部门对话和跨四个领域的结构化小组工作:政策和治理;融资和可持续性;公平和准入;以及实施和卫生系统。它遵循四个步骤:确定有关 HPV 疫苗接种 优先事项的国家政策问题、综合全球和地方证据、促进结构化的多部门审议以及共同制定政策建议。
elements_zh.main_results: 该实验室提出了优化乌干达 HPV 疫苗接种 的可行建议,并制作了第一份关于 HPV 疫苗接种 优先顺序的 CPL 政策简报,以供国家传播和政策参与。融资建议强调通过专门的初级卫生保健预算项目、增加政府共同融资以及利用国家成本效益分析来指导投资决策来加强国内资源调动。

papers.title_zh: 癌症政策实验室模型:加强乌干达循证 人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗接种 政策的卫生系统
papers.source_body_en: PURPOSE To establish and implement the Cancer Policy Lab (CPL) model as a structured platform to strengthen national health system capacity for translating global evidence into actionable cancer control policy and practice in Uganda. METHODS The CPL Uganda (CPL-U), convened by the ANANDA Centre for Cancer Research (ACCR), brought together stakeholders across different levels of the health system, including policymakers, clinicians, researchers, civil society organizations, patient representatives, and implementing partners. The Lab applied a systems-oriented approach combining evidence synthesis, multi-sector dialogue, and structured group work across four domains: policy and governance; financing and sustainability; equity and access; and implementation and health systems. The Lab followed a four-step process: (1) defining a national policy question on human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination prioritization; (2) synthesizing global and local evidence, including vaccine effectiveness, cost-efficiency, and delivery strategies; (3) facilitating structured multi-sector deliberations to assess feasibility within the Ugandan health system; and (4) co-producing policy recommendations and drafting a policy brief for decision-makers. RESULTS The Lab generated actionable recommendations to optimize HPV vaccination in Uganda and produced the first CPL policy brief on HPV vaccination prioritization for national dissemination and policy engagement. Recommendations included maintaining the single-dose HPV vaccination strategy, prioritizing girls aged 9-14 years with catch-up vaccination up to 20 years, and institutionalizing regular policy review to align with emerging evidence. Financing recommendations emphasized strengthening domestic resource mobilization through dedicated Primary Health Care budget lines, increased government co-financing, and use of national cost-benefit analysis to guide investment decisions. Equity recommendations focused on targeted outreach to underserved populations, including out-of-school girls and vulnerable groups, alongside strengthened communication strategies to improve vaccine acceptance and demand. Implementation recommendations included integrating HPV vaccination delivery across service platforms, strengthening health worker training, improving supply chain systems, reinforcing multi-sector coordination, and enhancing data systems for accountable programme scale-up. CONCLUSION Structured, facilitated multi-sector engagement enhanced ownership, feasibility, and policy relevance of recommendations. The CPL demonstrates a practical and scalable model for linking global evidence to local policy and implementation while strengthening health systems. The model has strong potential for replication across cancer control priorities and other health policy challenges in diverse settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的 建立和实施癌症政策实验室 (CPL) 模型,作为一个结构化平台,以加强国家卫生系统将全球证据转化为乌干达可操作的癌症控制政策和实践的能力。方法 乌干达 CPL(CPL-U)由 ANANDA 癌症研究中心(ACCR)召集,汇集了卫生系统不同层面的利益相关者,包括政策制定者、临床医生、研究人员、民间社会组织、患者代表和实施合作伙伴。该实验室采用了一种面向系统的方法,结合了证据合成、多部门对话和跨四个领域的结构化小组工作:政策和治理;融资和可持续性;公平和准入;以及实施和卫生系统。该实验室遵循四个步骤:(1) 定义关于 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗接种 优先级的国家政策问题;(2) 综合全球和当地证据,包括 疫苗 有效性、成本效率和交付策略;(3) 促进结构化的多部门审议,以评估乌干达卫生系统内的可行性;(4) 共同提出政策建议并为决策者起草政策简报。结果 实验室提出了优化乌干达 HPV 疫苗接种 的可行建议,并制作了第一份关于 HPV 疫苗接种 国家传播和政策参与优先事项的 CPL 政策简报。建议包括维持单剂 HPV 疫苗接种 策略、优先考虑 9-14 岁的女孩,并在 20 岁以内追赶 疫苗接种,以及将定期政策审查制度化,以与新出现的证据保持一致。融资建议强调通过专门的初级卫生保健预算项目、增加政府共同融资以及利用国家成本效益分析来指导投资决策来加强国内资源调动。公平建议的重点是有针对性地惠及服务不足的人群,包括失学女童和弱势群体,同时加强沟通策略,以提高 疫苗 的接受度和需求。实施建议包括整合跨服务平台的 HPV 疫苗接种 交付、加强卫生工作者培训、改善供应链系统、加强多部门协调以及增强负责项目规模扩大的数据系统。结论 结构化、便利的多部门参与增强了建议的所有权、可行性和政策相关性。CPL 展示了一种实用且可扩展的模型,可将全球证据与当地政策和实施联系起来,同时加强卫生系统。该模型具有在不同环境下的癌症控制优先事项和其他卫生政策挑战中复制的巨大潜力。

papers.title: Knowledge, Perceptions, Vaccine Uptake, and Reported Barriers to Human Papillomavirus (HPV) Vaccination Among Caregivers and Adolescent Girls in the Southern Senatorial District of Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria
papers.abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) remains a significant public health challenge in Nigeria, where cervical cancer ranks as the second most frequent cancer among women. Vaccination is a proven preventive strategy, yet uptake remains suboptimal. This study examined the knowledge, perceptions, vaccine uptake, and reported barriers to HPV vaccination among caregivers and adolescent girls in the Southern Senatorial District of Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria. Materials and Methods: A descriptive cross-sectional survey was conducted among 500 respondents (250 caregivers and 250 adolescent girls) selected through multi-stage random sampling. A structured, validated questionnaire was administered. Data were analyzed using the Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) version 23, and chi-square tests were used for hypothesis testing at the 95% confidence level. Results: Knowledge of HPV was low: 44.0% of caregivers and 26.0% of adolescent girls had heard of HPV, and only 25.2% of caregivers and 8.0% of adolescent girls demonstrated high knowledge. Among those aware of HPV, 22.7% of caregivers and 35.4% of adolescent girls had received the vaccine. No statistically significant associations were found between knowledge, perception, or demographic variables and vaccine uptake (all p > 0.05). Key barriers among caregivers included high cost (58.2%), unavailability (66.4%), safety concerns (35.5%), and need for more information (80.9%), which applied multiple responses. Conclusion: Knowledge of HPV and its vaccine is broadly poor among both caregivers and adolescent girls in the study area, and vaccine uptake remains low despite generally positive perceptions where awareness existed. Integration of the HPV vaccine into the national immunization programme, community sensitization, and improved healthcare provider communication are urgently recommended.

This study examined the knowledge, perceptions, vaccine uptake, and reported barriers to HPV vaccination among caregivers and adolescent girls in the Southern Senatorial District of Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria. Materials and Methods: A descriptive cross-sectional survey was conducted among 500 respondents (250 caregivers and 250 adolescent girls) selected through multi-stage random sampling. A structured, validated questionnaire was administered. Data were analyzed using the Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) version 23, and chi-square tests were used for hypothesis testing at the 95% confidence level. Results: Knowledge of HPV was low: 44.0% of caregivers and 26.0% of adolescent girls had heard of HPV, and only 25.2% of caregivers and 8.0% of adolescent girls demonstrated high knowledge. Among those aware of HPV, 22.7% of caregivers and 35.4% of adolescent girls had received the vaccine. No statistically significant associations were found between knowledge, perception, or demographic variables and vaccine uptake (all p > 0.05). Key barriers among caregivers included high cost (58.2%), unavailability (66.4%), safety concerns (35.5%), and need for more information (80.9%), which applied multiple responses. Conclusion: Knowledge of HPV and its vaccine is broadly poor among both caregivers and adolescent girls in the study area, and vaccine uptake remains low despite generally positive perceptions where awareness existed. Integration of the HPV vaccine into the national immunization programme, community sensitization, and improved healthcare provider communication are urgently recommended.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 仍然是尼日利亚的一个重大公共卫生挑战,宫颈癌 是女性中第二常见的癌症。该研究旨在调查尼日利亚阿夸伊博姆州南部参议院区的护理人员和青春期女孩对 HPV 疫苗接种 的了解、看法、疫苗 的吸收情况以及报告的障碍。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 对通过多阶段随机抽样选出的 500 名受访者(250 名护理人员和 250 名青春期女孩)进行了描述性横断面调查。该研究使用了经过验证的结构化调查问卷,并使用社会科学统计软件包 (SPSS) 23 版分析数据,并在 95% 的置信水平下进行了卡方检验。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 对HPV的了解程度较低:44.0%的照顾者和26.0%的青春期女孩听说过HPV,只有25.2%的照顾者和8.0%的青春期女孩表现出较高的知晓率。在了解 HPV 的人群中,22.7% 的护理人员和 35.4% 的青春期女孩接受了 疫苗。知识、感知或人口统计变量与 疫苗 的吸收之间没有发现统计学上显着的关联。护理人员面临的主要障碍包括成本高(58.2%)、无法获得服务(66.4%)、安全问题(35.5%)和需要更多信息(80.9%)。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 研究发现,研究地区的护理人员和青春期女孩对 HPV 及其 疫苗 的了解普遍较差,尽管存在普遍积极的认识,但 疫苗 的采用率仍然很低。该研究没有发现知识、感知或人口统计变量与 疫苗 的吸收之间存在统计学上的显着关联,这表明其他因素可能会影响 疫苗 的吸收。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 迫切建议将 HPV 疫苗 纳入国家免疫规划、社区宣传和改善医疗保健提供者沟通。这些措施有助于提高 疫苗 的使用率并提高公众对 HPV 及其 疫苗 的了解。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Chatbot Accuracy for Patient Education in HPV Infection
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Chatbots are artificial intelligence (AI) tools that use large language models to answer questions and simulate human-like conversations. Chatbots are commonly used by patients for self-education regarding medical issues. The accuracy of information obtained through patient self-education searches using Chatbots for Human Papillomavirus (HPV) infection and recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP) is unknown. This work is intended to analyze aspects of chatbot answers to common patient questions regarding laryngeal HPV infection and RRP. METHODS: Eight questions were asked by the authors to mimic real-world patient queries to three different Chatbot models (Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini). Two fellowship-trained laryngologists blindly rated eight answers for each model using a 5-point Likert scale regarding accuracy, comprehensiveness, and similarity to a response the rating physician would themselves offer. Descriptive and statistical analyses were performed. RESULTS: Gemini had the highest overall mean score (4.7, SD 0.5), and Claude had the lowest (4, SD 0.7). Gemini had the highest individual scores for each aspect evaluated. Between the aspects analyzed across all platforms, accuracy was scored highest (4.4, SD 0.6), but the difference was not robust. The one-way ANOVA test showed an overall significant difference between the three platforms (P < 0.0001). A paired comparison between platforms was performed using a post hoc Tukey test, and the results were only significant when Gemini was compared individually with ChatGPT and Claude (P < 0.0001). CONCLUSION: Gemini had the highest overall and individual rated scores for answer accuracy, comprehensiveness, and similarity to what physician raters would offer their patients. It was the only chatbot platform that demonstrated a robust difference when compared to the others regarding answers to common patient questions on laryngeal HPV infection/RRP.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估聊天机器人对有关喉部 HPV 感染和复发性呼吸道乳头状瘤病 (RRP) 的常见患者问题的反应准确性。使用聊天机器人进行 HPV 感染和 RRP 患者自我教育搜索所获得的信息的准确性尚不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项工作使用三种不同的聊天机器人模型(Claude、ChatGPT 和 Gemini)分析了聊天机器人对有关喉部 HPV 感染和 RRP 的八个问题的回答。作者进行这项研究是为了模仿现实世界中患者的询问。
elements_zh.methods: 作者提出了八个问题,以模拟现实世界中患者对三种不同聊天机器人模型(Claude、ChatGPT 和 Gemini)的询问。两名接受过专科培训的喉科医生使用 5 点李克特量表对每个模型的八个答案进行盲目评分,评估内容包括准确性、全面性以及与评分医生自己提供的答案的相似性。进行了描述性和统计分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 双子座的总体平均得分最高(4.7,SD 0.5),克劳德的得分最低(4,SD 0.7)。双子座在每个评估方面的个人得分最高。单向方差分析测试显示三个平台之间存在总体显着差异(P < 0.0001)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 双子座在答案准确性、全面性以及与医生评分者向患者提供的答案的相似性方面具有最高的总体和个人评分。与其他聊天机器人平台相比,它是唯一一个在回答有关喉部 HPV 感染/RRP 的常见患者问题方面表现出显着差异的聊天机器人平台。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为用于 HPV 感染和 RRP 患者教育的聊天机器人平台的开发和评估提供信息,强调选择准确和全面的人工智能工具进行医疗交流的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于一小部分八个问题和三个聊天机器人模型,这可能无法完全代表患者询问的范围或人工智能平台的多样性。由于研究的受控性质和缺乏更广泛的普遍性,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.main_results: 双子座的总体平均得分最高(4.7,SD 0.5),克劳德的得分最低(4,SD 0.7)。双子座在每个评估方面的个人得分最高。单向方差分析测试显示三个平台之间存在总体显着差异(P < 0.0001)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 双子座在答案准确性、全面性以及与医生评分者向患者提供的答案的相似性方面具有最高的总体和个人评分。与其他聊天机器人平台相比,它是唯一一个在回答有关喉部 HPV 感染/RRP 的常见患者问题方面表现出显着差异的聊天机器人平台。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为用于 HPV 感染和 RRP 患者教育的聊天机器人平台的开发和评估提供信息,强调选择准确和全面的人工智能工具进行医疗交流的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于一小部分八个问题和三个聊天机器人模型,这可能无法完全代表患者询问的范围或人工智能平台的多样性。由于研究的受控性质和缺乏更广泛的普遍性,证据强度中等。

papers.title: E8^E2 controls the formation of E2-positive replication centers that precede E4 expression during productive HPV16 infection
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) couple their replication cycle to keratinocyte differentiation. Viral genomes are maintained at low copy numbers in undifferentiated cells and undergo amplification within nuclear replication foci in differentiated suprabasal cells. The viral proteins E2 and E8^E2 function as activators and repressors of viral replication, respectively. Using a novel polyclonal antiserum together with the monoclonal antibody 22E2-B9, which recognize both E2 and E8^E2, we identified distinct nuclear E2 foci in keratinocytes harboring episomal HPV16 wild-type (wt) or E8^E2 mutant genomes. These foci colocalized with viral genomes and the cellular proteins RPA32, RAD51, γH2AX, and BRD4, consistent with viral replication centers. Cell-cycle analysis showed that E2 foci formed during the S phase and persisted into the G2 phase. Loss of E8^E2 expression or repression activity increased the number of replication foci and induced diffuse nuclear E2 staining. Only a subset of E2 focus-positive cells expressed the late viral protein E4, indicating that replication centers arise before robust late gene expression. In organotypic cultures, E2 focus-positive/E4-negative cells were detected in suprabasal layers before E2 focus-positive/E4-positive cells, whereas E2-negative/E4-positive cells suggested dynamic regulation of E2 during productive infection. Moreover, many wt cells displayed E2 focus phenotypes resembling E8^E2 mutant cells, suggesting that E8^E2 activity declines during keratinocyte differentiation. These findings demonstrate that E2-positive viral replication centers are tightly regulated by E8^E2, emerge early during productive HPV16 infection, and are accompanied by dynamic modulation of E2 and E8^E2 during the productive phase of the viral life cycle. IMPORTANCE: Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) couple their replication cycle to keratinocyte differentiation, but the mechanisms controlling productive viral genome amplification remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify distinct E2-positive nuclear replication centers in HPV16-infected keratinocytes and show that they contain viral genomes and cellular factors involved in DNA replication and repair. We demonstrate that these structures form during the S phase, persist into the G2 phase, and arise before robust expression of the late viral E4 protein, indicating that viral genome amplification is initiated earlier in the productive cycle than previously appreciated. We further show that the viral repressor E8^E2 regulates the organization of E2-positive replication centers and that E8^E2 activity appears to decline during keratinocyte differentiation. Together, our findings reveal dynamic regulation of E2 and E8^E2 during productive HPV16 infection and provide new insights into how viral genome amplification and late gene expression are coordinated in differentiating epithelial cells.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) couple their replication cycle to keratinocyte differentiation, but the mechanisms controlling productive viral genome amplification remain incompletely understood.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study investigated HPV16-infected keratinocytes using a novel polyclonal antiserum and monoclonal antibody 22E2-B9 to identify distinct nuclear E2 foci. It also examined organotypic cultures to observe the dynamics of E2 and E4 expression during the productive cycle.
analysis.methods: The researchers used a novel polyclonal antiserum and monoclonal antibody 22E2-B9 to detect E2 and E8^E2 proteins. They analyzed cell-cycle phases and observed the localization of viral genomes and cellular factors in HPV16-infected keratinocytes.
analysis.main_results: Cell-cycle analysis showed that E2 foci formed during the S phase and persisted into the G2 phase. Loss of E8^E2 expression or repression activity increased the number of replication foci and induced diffuse nuclear E2 staining. In organotypic cultures, E2 focus-positive/E4-negative cells were detected in suprabasal layers before E2 focus-positive/E4-positive cells.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that E2-positive viral replication centers are tightly regulated by E8^E2, emerge early during productive HPV16 infection, and are accompanied by dynamic modulation of E2 and E8^E2 during the productive phase of the viral life cycle.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings provide new insights into how viral genome amplification and late gene expression are coordinated in differentiating epithelial cells, which may inform future studies on HPV replication and its implications for disease progression.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on HPV16-infected keratinocytes and organotypic cultures, which may not fully represent in vivo conditions. The evidence is moderate, as it is based on immunofluorescence and cell-cycle analysis without direct functional validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of E8^E2 in regulating E2-positive nuclear replication centers during productive HPV16 infection. It demonstrates that these replication centers form during the S phase and persist into the G2 phase, preceding the expression of the late viral protein E4. The research highlights the dynamic regulation of E2 and E8^E2 during the viral life cycle and provides new insights into the coordination of genome amplification and late gene expression in differentiating epithelial cells. The study uses immunofluorescence and cell-cycle analysis to observe these phenomena, but its findings are limited to in vitro models and may not fully reflect in vivo conditions. The results contribute to understanding HPV replication mechanisms, which could have implications for the development of targeted therapies or interventions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 将其复制周期与角质细胞分化结合起来,但控制生产性病毒 基因组 扩增的机制仍不完全清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用新型多克隆抗血清和单克隆抗体 22E2-B9 研究了 HPV16 感染的角质形成细胞,以识别不同的核 E2 病灶。它还检查了器官型培养物,以观察生产周期中 E2 和 E4 表达的动态。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用新型多克隆抗血清和单克隆抗体22E2-B9来检测E2和E8^E2蛋白。他们分析了细胞周期阶段并观察了病毒 基因组 和细胞因子在 HPV16 感染的角质形成细胞中的定位。
elements_zh.main_results: 细胞周期分析表明,E2 灶在 S 期形成并持续进入 G2 期。E8^E2 表达或抑制活性的丧失增加了复制灶的数量并诱导弥漫性核 E2 染色。在器官型培养物中,在基底上层中先检测到 E2 灶阳性/E4 阴性细胞,然后再检测到 E2 灶阳性/E4 阳性细胞。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,E2 阳性病毒复制中心受到 E8^E2 的严格调控,在生产性 HPV16 感染期间早期出现,并在病毒生命周期的生产阶段伴随着 E2 和 E8^E2 的动态调节。

papers.title_zh: 在生产性 HPV16 感染期间,E8^E2 控制 E2 阳性复制中心的形成,该复制中心先于 E4 表达
papers.source_body_en: UNLABELLED: Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) couple their replication cycle to keratinocyte differentiation. Viral genomes are maintained at low copy numbers in undifferentiated cells and undergo amplification within nuclear replication foci in differentiated suprabasal cells. The viral proteins E2 and E8^E2 function as activators and repressors of viral replication, respectively. Using a novel polyclonal antiserum together with the monoclonal antibody 22E2-B9, which recognize both E2 and E8^E2, we identified distinct nuclear E2 foci in keratinocytes harboring episomal HPV16 wild-type (wt) or E8^E2 mutant genomes. These foci colocalized with viral genomes and the cellular proteins RPA32, RAD51, γH2AX, and BRD4, consistent with viral replication centers. Cell-cycle analysis showed that E2 foci formed during the S phase and persisted into the G2 phase. Loss of E8^E2 expression or repression activity increased the number of replication foci and induced diffuse nuclear E2 staining. Only a subset of E2 focus-positive cells expressed the late viral protein E4, indicating that replication centers arise before robust late gene expression. In organotypic cultures, E2 focus-positive/E4-negative cells were detected in suprabasal layers before E2 focus-positive/E4-positive cells, whereas E2-negative/E4-positive cells suggested dynamic regulation of E2 during productive infection. Moreover, many wt cells displayed E2 focus phenotypes resembling E8^E2 mutant cells, suggesting that E8^E2 activity declines during keratinocyte differentiation. These findings demonstrate that E2-positive viral replication centers are tightly regulated by E8^E2, emerge early during productive HPV16 infection, and are accompanied by dynamic modulation of E2 and E8^E2 during the productive phase of the viral life cycle. IMPORTANCE: Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) couple their replication cycle to keratinocyte differentiation, but the mechanisms controlling productive viral genome amplification remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify distinct E2-positive nuclear replication centers in HPV16-infected keratinocytes and show that they contain viral genomes and cellular factors involved in DNA replication and repair. We demonstrate that these structures form during the S phase, persist into the G2 phase, and arise before robust expression of the late viral E4 protein, indicating that viral genome amplification is initiated earlier in the productive cycle than previously appreciated. We further show that the viral repressor E8^E2 regulates the organization of E2-positive replication centers and that E8^E2 activity appears to decline during keratinocyte differentiation. Together, our findings reveal dynamic regulation of E2 and E8^E2 during productive HPV16 infection and provide new insights into how viral genome amplification and late gene expression are coordinated in differentiating epithelial cells.
papers.abstract_zh: 未标记:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 将其复制周期与角质形成细胞分化结合起来。病毒基因组在未分化细胞中维持低拷贝数,并在分化的上基底细胞中的核复制灶内进行扩增。病毒蛋白E2和E8^E2分别充当病毒复制的激活剂和抑制剂。使用新型多克隆抗血清和可识别 E2 和 E8^E2 的单克隆抗体 22E2-B9,我们在含有附加型 HPV16 野生型 (wt) 或 E8^E2 突变体 基因组 的角质形成细胞中鉴定出不同的核 E2 灶。这些病灶与病毒 基因组 和细胞蛋白 RPA32、RAD51、γH2AX 和 BRD4 共定位,与病毒复制中心一致。细胞周期分析表明,E2 灶在 S 期形成并持续进入 G2 期。E8^E2 表达或抑制活性的丧失增加了复制灶的数量并诱导弥漫性核 E2 染色。只有一部分 E2 灶阳性细胞表达晚期病毒蛋白 E4,表明复制中心在强大的晚期基因表达之前出现。在器官型培养物中,在E2焦点阳性/E4阳性细胞之前,在基底上层中检测到E2焦点阳性/E4阴性细胞,而E2​​阴性/E4阳性细胞表明在生产性感染期间E2的动态调节。此外,许多wt细胞表现出类似于E8^E2突变细胞的E2焦点表型,表明E8^E2活性在角质形成细胞分化过程中下降。这些发现表明,E2阳性病毒复制中心受到E8^E2的严格调控,在生产性HPV16感染期间早期出现,并在病毒生命周期的生产阶段伴随着E2和E8^E2的动态调节。重要性:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 将其复制周期与角质形成细胞分化联系起来,但控制生产性病毒 基因组 扩增的机制仍不完全清楚。在这里,我们在 HPV16 感染的角质形成细胞中鉴定出不同的 E2 阳性核复制中心,并表明它们含有病毒 基因组 和参与 DNA 复制和修复的细胞因子。我们证明这些结构在 S 期形成,持续到 G2 期,并在晚期病毒 E4 蛋白的稳健表达之前出现,表明病毒 基因组 扩增在生产周期中比之前预想的更早开始。我们进一步表明,病毒阻遏蛋白 E8^E2 调节 E2 阳性复制中心的组织,并且 E8^E2 活性在角质形成细胞分化过程中似乎下降。总之,我们的研究结果揭示了高效 HPV16 感染期间 E2 和 E8^E2 的动态调节,并为病毒 基因组 扩增和晚期基因表达在上皮细胞分化过程中如何协调提供了新的见解。

papers.title: De Pilotos Locais a Programas Escaláveis: Implementando o Rastreamento do Câncer Cervical Baseado em Human Papillomavirus na América Latina
papers.abstract: PURPOSE Cervical cancer is a leading cause of cancer death among women in Latin America, where many countries are classified as low- and middle-income and experience some of the highest incidence and mortality rates globally. The WHO has launched a global strategy to eliminate cervical cancer as a public health problem, setting 90-70-90 targets by 2030, including 70% screening coverage with a high-performance test, preferably human papillomavirus (HPV) testing, at ages 35 and 45. This narrative review synthesizes recent experience with HPV-based cervical cancer screening in Latin America, highlighting local pilots and programmatic implementations, key barriers and facilitators, and lessons with potential for global impact. METHODS We conducted a narrative review of publications and reports from 2010 to 2026 on HPV-based screening in Latin American countries, using PubMed and major global health sources. We prioritized studies describing real-world implementation or large research platforms such as the International Agency for Research on Cancer-led ESTAMPA study, programmatic HPV testing in Argentina and Mexico, and self-sampling initiatives in rural Ecuador, including quantitative and qualitative assessments of barriers, facilitators, and acceptability. RESULTS Across Latin America, HPV testing has been introduced at scale or in large pilots through initiatives such as ESTAMPA, which evaluates organized HPV-based screening and triage strategies in multiple sites and informs approaches for scale-up. Argentina has been a regional pioneer: the province of Jujuy was the first to implement HPV testing as the primary screening method, including community health worker–delivered self-collection, and has now implemented a second round of HPV-based screening. Experience from nine Latin American countries shows that HPV testing is feasible and a promising tool to reduce cervical cancer burden, although higher test costs and health system constraints remain challenges. In rural Ecuador, diagnostic studies showed that vaginal and urine self-sampling have sensitivity and specificity comparable to clinician-collected samples, while community-based pilots reported high acceptability, with perceived advantages such as comfort, privacy, and time savings. CONCLUSION Latin American experiences demonstrate that HPV-based screening and self-sampling can be effectively implemented in diverse health systems, particularly when integrated with primary care and supported by community outreach. These local “laboratories” of implementation reveal common barriers and key facilitators and offer practical lessons for other settings.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的 宫颈癌 是拉丁美洲女性癌症死亡的主要原因,该地区许多国家都属于低收入和中等收入国家,并且 发病率 和 死亡率 发病率是全球最高的。世卫组织启动了一项消除 宫颈癌 这一公共卫生问题的全球战略,设定了到 2030 年 90-70-90 的目标,其中包括在 35 岁和 45 岁通过高性能检测实现 70% 的筛查覆盖率,最好是 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 检测。这篇叙述性综述综合了拉丁美洲基于 HPV 的 宫颈癌 筛查的最新经验,重点介绍了当地试点和规划实施、关键障碍和促进因素,以及可能产生全球影响的教训。方法 我们利用 PubMed 和全球主要卫生资源,对 2010 年至 2026 年拉丁美洲国家有关 HPV 筛查的出版物和报告进行了叙述性回顾。我们优先考虑描述现实世界实施或大型研究平台的研究,例如国际癌症研究机构主导的ESTAMPA研究、阿根廷和墨西哥的计划性HPV检测以及厄瓜多尔农村的自我采样举措,包括对障碍、促进因素和可接受性的定量和定性评估。结果 在整个拉丁美洲,HPV 检测已通过 ESTAMPA 等举措大规模引入或进行了大型试点,该计划评估多个地点有组织的基于 HPV 的筛查和分诊策略,并为扩大规模的方法提供信息。阿根廷是该地区的先行者:胡胡伊省是第一个实施 HPV 检测作为初级筛查方法的国家,其中包括社区卫生工作者自行采集,目前已实施第二轮 HPV 筛查。九个拉丁美洲国家的经验表明,HPV 检测是可行的,并且是减少 宫颈癌 负担的有前途的工具,尽管较高的检测成本和卫生系统的限制仍然是挑战。在厄瓜多尔农村地区,诊断研究表明,阴道和尿液自我采样的敏感性和特异性与临床医生采集的样本相当,而社区试点报告的可接受性很高,具有舒适、隐私和节省时间等明显优势。结论 拉丁美洲的经验表明,基于 HPV 的筛查和自我采样可以在不同的卫生系统中有效实施,特别是在与初级保健相结合并得到社区外展支持时。这些当地的实施“实验室”揭示了常见的障碍和关键的促进因素,并为其他环境提供了实践经验教训。

papers.title: Covalent Ligands that Target the Human Papillomavirus E6 Oncoprotein
papers.abstract: The high‐risk human papillomavirus (HPV) early protein 6 (E6) viral oncoprotein is a key player in HPV‐mediated cancers and is the major driver of cervical, anal, and a substantial portion of head and neck cancers. HPV E6 recruits the cellular ubiquitin E3‐ligase E6‐associated protein (E6AP), also termed UBE3A, and this E6/E6AP complex in turn recruits the tumor suppressor p53, resulting in the ubiquitin‐mediated degradation of p53. The cysteine‐rich E6 protein presents an attractive target for chemical intervention through covalent, cysteine‐reactive chemistries. While previous studies have uncovered peptidic covalent inhibitors of E6, we sought to determine whether we could identify nonpeptidic functional binders. We screened a library of cysteine‐reactive covalent ligands and identified a pyrazoline hit, EN218, bearing a chloroacetamide cysteine‐reactive warhead. Evaluation of pyrazoline analogs led to the development of an improved molecule, ( S )‐WX48A, that stereoselectively reacted with C58 on E6 to inhibit E6‐mediated p53 ubiquitination. While this molecule is still in an early stage and requires further medicinal chemistry optimization to exert on‐target cellular activity, our study demonstrates that E6 can be directly and stereoselectively targeted with a covalent nonpeptidic small‐molecule and provides a foundation for developing more drug‐like E6 inhibitors for HPV therapy.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探索针对 HPV E6 癌蛋白的化学干预措施,该蛋白对于 HPV 介导的癌症(包括宫颈癌、肛门癌和头颈癌)至关重要。该研究试图解决对非肽功能结合剂作为肽抑制剂替代品的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及筛选半胱氨酸反应性共价配体库,以确定 HPV E6 癌蛋白的潜在抑制剂。重点是 E6 蛋白在招募 E6AP 和降解 p53 方面的作用,这在 HPV 相关癌症中至关重要。
elements_zh.methods: 筛选半胱氨酸反应性共价配体库以鉴定功能性结合物。该研究评估了吡唑啉类似物,以开发一种改进的分子,该分子可与 E6 上的 C58 发生立体选择性反应,从而抑制 E6 介导的 p53 泛素化。
elements_zh.main_results: 吡唑啉弹 EN218 被鉴定为带有氯乙酰胺半胱氨酸反应弹头。进一步的评估导致了 (S)-WX48A 的开发,它与 E6 上的 C58 发生立体选择性反应,抑制 E6 介导的 p53 泛素化。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,E6 可以直接立体选择性地靶向共价非肽小分子,为开发更多用于 HPV 治疗的药物样 E6 抑制剂提供了一种新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为开发针对 HPV E6 的新治疗药物奠定了基础,这可能会改善 治疗 治疗 HPV 相关癌症(如宫颈癌、肛门癌和口咽癌)的效果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该分子仍处于早期阶段,需要进一步的药物化学优化以发挥靶向细胞活性,这表明由于结果的初步性质,证据的强度适中。

papers.title: Study on the molecular mechanism of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells inducing epithelial-mesenchymal transition in HPV-associated cervical cancer through activation of miR-129.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: HPV-associated cervical cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related death in women worldwide. The role of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) and miR-129 in tumor progression remains unclear. OBJECTIVES: To investigate miR-129 expression and its clinical significance in HPV-associated cervical cancer and to explore whether BMSCs regulate malignant phenotypes through miR-129. METHODS: miR-129 expression was measured by qRT-PCR in 77 cervical cancer and 30 normal cervical tissues. Associations with clinicopathological features and overall survival (OS) were analyzed. Diagnostic value was assessed by ROC curve. Rat BMSCs were co-cultured with SiHa and HeLa cells. Following miR-129 overexpression or knockdown, cell proliferation (CCK-8, colony formation), invasion (Transwell) and expression of E-cadherin, N-cadherin and MRP1 (Western blot) were examined. RESULTS: miR-129 expression was significantly higher in cervical cancer tissues than in normal controls (3.24±0.56 vs. High miR-129 expression correlated with tumor size ≥3 cm (P=0.009), FIGO stage III-IV (P=0.0034) and lymph node metastasis (P=0.038). High expression was associated with shorter OS (median: 28.4 vs. 46.2 months; HR=2.944, 95%CI:1.484-5.842, P=0.002). papers.title: The assembly pathway for human papillomavirus L1 capsid protein is encoded in electrostatic interactions.
papers.abstract: Human papillomavirus L1 protein spontaneously folds and assembles into 60 nm virus-like particles (VLP), with T = 7d icosahedral symmetry at high salt concentrations but not in low salt. Rapid increase from low to high salt during the assembly process gives poor-quality VLPs, while slowly increasing salt, over as many as 48 h, gives rise to high-quality VLPs. Insight into this behavior is drawn from a computational model based on the cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structure of the human papillomavirus Type 16 VLP. Electrostatic potential energy barriers were calculated using the linearized Poisson-Boltzmann equation. After initial, rapid oligomerization of monomers into symmetrical pentamers (capsomeres), these units form pairwise interactions in energetic order, lowest barrier first. But at high salt concentrations, the energetic barriers are more or less equal and irregular particles form, both in simulation and in experiments. The interaction interfaces were modified by mutation to favor the smaller, 30 nm T = 1 icosahedral symmetry and disfavor T = 7d symmetry. The results were smaller particles. By carefully controlling ionic strength, and/or by mutating interface residues by design, it is possible to make high quality, highly immunogenic VLPs directly from unpurified bacterial lysate, without requiring the use of a disassembly/reassembly step.
papers.journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society

papers.source_body_en: Human papillomavirus L1 protein spontaneously folds and assembles into 60 nm virus-like particles (VLP), with T = 7d icosahedral symmetry at high salt concentrations but not in low salt. Rapid increase from low to high salt during the assembly process gives poor-quality VLPs, while slowly increasing salt, over as many as 48 h, gives rise to high-quality VLPs. Insight into this behavior is drawn from a computational model based on the cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structure of the human papillomavirus Type 16 VLP. Electrostatic potential energy barriers were calculated using the linearized Poisson-Boltzmann equation. After initial, rapid oligomerization of monomers into symmetrical pentamers (capsomeres), these units form pairwise interactions in energetic order, lowest barrier first. But at high salt concentrations, the energetic barriers are more or less equal and irregular particles form, both in simulation and in experiments. The interaction interfaces were modified by mutation to favor the smaller, 30 nm T = 1 icosahedral symmetry and disfavor T = 7d symmetry. The results were smaller particles. By carefully controlling ionic strength, and/or by mutating interface residues by design, it is possible to make high quality, highly immunogenic VLPs directly from unpurified bacterial lysate, without requiring the use of a disassembly/reassembly step.

papers.title: Diagnostic accuracy of a systematic approach using Swedescore versus conventional colposcopy for the detection of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 or worse: A multicenter, non-randomized clinical study.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Globally, colposcopy is often performed by non-experts with no certification or routine use of colposcopic scoring tools. A systematic colposcopic scoring tool, the Swedescore, has been developed to enhance the detection rate of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 or worse (CIN2+). We aimed to compare the diagnostic accuracy of two colposcopy methods (systematic use of the Swedescore versus conventional colposcopy) for detecting CIN2+. MATERIAL AND METHODS: This multicenter, non-randomized clinical study included women (23-65 years) referred for colposcopy and with a visible transformation zone (type 1 and 2). Colposcopy was performed using the systematic scoring tool, Swedescore, or the conventional method. All women had four cervical biopsies collected. Colposcopists collected lesion-directed biopsies (target biopsies) from abnormal areas with or without non-lesion-directed biopsies (random biopsies) from areas that appeared normal. The gold standard was the most severe diagnosis (CIN2+) based on all four biopsies. The primary outcome was CIN2+. We calculated sensitivity (SN), specificity (SP), positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV) with 95% confidence intervals and compared results between the two methods. Results were stratified by age, body mass index (BMI), human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination status, screening method, index cytology, index HPV type, and colposcopists. Clinical Trial Registration ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05870787. RESULTS: Among 929 women included (Swedescore: 534, conventional: 395), the diagnostic accuracy for the detection of CIN2+ was slightly higher with the Swedescore compared to the conventional method (SN: 84.7% vs. 77.8%, SP: 37.3% vs. 30.9%, PPV: 47.6% vs. 43.9%, NPV: 78.3% vs. Sensitivity for CIN2+ was significantly higher with the Swedescore compared to the conventional method in women ≥50 years (92.9% vs. 62.5%), those with high-grade cytology (92.4% vs. 83.2%), and when colposcopy was performed by residents (91.8% vs. Regardless of HPV vaccination status and screening method, the Swedescore performed slightly better than the conventional method, although the differences were not statistically significant. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings may suggest that, in a non-expert setting, a systematic colposcopic examination using the Swedescore was associated with a slightly higher diagnostic accuracy for detecting CIN2+ compared to the conventional method. These findings should be interpreted considering baseline imbalances between the two methods.

A systematic colposcopic scoring tool, the Swedescore, has been developed to enhance the detection rate of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 or worse (CIN2+). We aimed to compare the diagnostic accuracy of two colposcopy methods (systematic use of the Swedescore versus conventional colposcopy) for detecting CIN2+. MATERIAL AND METHODS: This multicenter, non-randomized clinical study included women (23-65 years) referred for colposcopy and with a visible transformation zone (type 1 and 2). Colposcopy was performed using the systematic scoring tool, Swedescore, or the conventional method. All women had four cervical biopsies collected. Colposcopists collected lesion-directed biopsies (target biopsies) from abnormal areas with or without non-lesion-directed biopsies (random biopsies) from areas that appeared normal. The gold standard was the most severe diagnosis (CIN2+) based on all four biopsies. The primary outcome was CIN2+. We calculated sensitivity (SN), specificity (SP), positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV) with 95% confidence intervals and compared results between the two methods. Results were stratified by age, body mass index (BMI), human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination status, screening method, index cytology, index HPV type, and colposcopists. Clinical Trial Registration ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05870787. RESULTS: Among 929 women included (Swedescore: 534, conventional: 395), the diagnostic accuracy for the detection of CIN2+ was slightly higher with the Swedescore compared to the conventional method (SN: 84.7% vs. 77.8%, SP: 37.3% vs. 30.9%, PPV: 47.6% vs. 43.9%, NPV: 78.3% vs. Sensitivity for CIN2+ was significantly higher with the Swedescore compared to the conventional method in women ≥50 years (92.9% vs. 62.5%), those with high-grade cytology (92.4% vs. 83.2%), and when colposcopy was performed by residents (91.8% vs. Regardless of HPV vaccination status and screening method, the Swedescore performed slightly better than the conventional method, although the differences were not statistically significant. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings may suggest that, in a non-expert setting, a systematic colposcopic examination using the Swedescore was associated with a slightly higher diagnostic accuracy for detecting CIN2+ compared to the conventional method. These findings should be interpreted considering baseline imbalances between the two methods.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to compare the diagnostic accuracy of two colposcopy methods—systematic use of the Swedescore versus conventional colposcopy—for detecting cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 or worse (CIN2+). The study included 929 women (23-65 years) with visible transformation zones and was conducted in a multicenter, non-randomized setting. Colposcopists used either the Swedescore or conventional methods, and all participants had four cervical biopsies collected. The primary outcome was CIN2+, with the gold standard based on the most severe diagnosis from all biopsies. The results showed that the Swedescore had slightly higher sensitivity for CIN2+ compared to the conventional method, particularly in women ≥50 years, those with high-grade cytology, and when performed by residents. However, the differences were not statistically significant. The study suggests that systematic colposcopic scoring tools may improve diagnostic accuracy in non-expert settings, which could have implications for cervical cancer screening programs. The findings should be interpreted with caution due to baseline imbalances between the methods and the non-randomized design.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 在全球范围内,阴道镜检查通常由非专家进行,没有经过认证或没有常规使用阴道镜评分工具。系统性阴道镜评分工具 Swedescore 的开发旨在提高 2 级或更严重的宫颈上皮内瘤变 (CIN2+) 的检出率。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项多中心、非随机临床研究纳入了转诊接受阴道镜检查并具有可见变性区(1 型和 2 型)的女性(23-65 岁)。使用系统评分工具 Swedescore 或传统方法进行阴道镜检查。
elements_zh.methods: 我们计算了具有 95% 置信区间的敏感性 (SN)、特异性 (SP)、阳性预测值 (PPV) 和阴性预测值 (NPV),并比较了两种方法的结果。所有女性均采集了四份宫颈活检样本。阴道镜检查人员从异常区域收集病变定向活检(目标活检),并从看似正常的区域收集或不收集非病变定向活检(随机活检)。
elements_zh.main_results: 在纳入的 929 名女性中(Swedescore:534,传统:395),与传统方法相比,Swedescore 检测 CIN2+ 的诊断准确性略高(SN:84.7% vs. 77.8%,SP:37.3% vs. 30.9%,PPV:47.6% vs. 43.9%,NPV:78.3% vs.与传统方法相比,Swedescore 对 50 岁以上女性(92.9% vs. 62.5%)、具有高级细胞学检查的女性(92.4% vs. 83.2%)以及住院医师进行阴道镜检查(91.8% vs. 83.2%)的 CIN2+ 的敏感性显着更高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 无论 HPV 疫苗接种 状态和筛查方法如何,Swedescore 的表现均略优于传统方法,但差异不具有统计学意义。我们的研究结果可能表明,在非专家环境中,与传统方法相比,使用 Swedescore 进行系统阴道镜检查与检测 CIN2+ 的诊断准确性稍高相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于在非专家环境中使用系统阴道镜评分工具来改善 CIN2+ 的检测,并可能增强 宫颈癌 筛查计划。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 应考虑两种方法之间的基线不平衡来解释这些发现。该研究是非随机的,诊断准确性的差异没有统计学意义。

papers.abstract_zh: INTRODUCTION: 全球范围内,宫颈镜检查通常由未经认证的非专家人员进行,且不常规使用宫颈镜评分工具。为提高宫颈上皮内瘤变2级或以上(CIN2+)的检出率,已开发出一种系统性的宫颈镜评分工具Swedescore。我们旨在比较两种宫颈镜检查方法(系统性使用Swedescore与传统宫颈镜检查)在检测CIN2+方面的诊断准确性。MATERIAL AND METHODS: 本研究是一项多中心、非随机的临床研究,纳入了23-65岁因宫颈镜检查而被转诊且可见转化区(类型1和2)的女性。宫颈镜检查采用系统性评分工具Swedescore或传统方法进行。所有女性均采集了四份宫颈活检样本。宫颈镜检查人员从异常区域采集病变导向活检(目标活检),并根据需要从看似正常的区域采集非病变导向活检(随机活检)。金标准是基于所有四份活检样本确定的最严重宫颈上皮内瘤变2级或以上(CIN2+)。主要结局是CIN2+。我们计算了敏感度(SN)、特异度(SP)、阳性预测值(PPV)和阴性预测值(NPV)的95%置信区间,并比较了两种方法的结果。结果按年龄、体重指数(BMI)、高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)状态、筛查方法、索引细胞学检查、索引HPV类型以及宫颈镜检查人员进行分层。临床试验注册号 ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05870787. RESULTS: 共纳入929名女性(Swedescore组534名,传统方法组395名),Swedescore组在检测CIN2+的诊断准确性方面略高于传统方法组(SN: 84.7% vs. 77.8%,SP: 37.3% vs. 30.9%,PPV: 47.6% vs. 43.9%,NPV: 78.3% vs. 76.5%)。在≥50岁的女性中,Swedescore组的敏感度显著高于传统方法组(92.9% vs. 62.5%);在高危型HPV状态的女性中,Swedescore组的敏感度显著高于传统方法组(92.4% vs. 83.2%);当由实习医生进行宫颈镜检查时,Swedescore组的敏感度也显著高于传统方法组(91.8% vs. 79.5%)。无论HPV状态如何或筛查方法如何,Swedescore组的诊断准确性均略优于传统方法组,但差异无统计学意义。CONCLUSIONS: 我们的研究结果可能表明,在非专家环境下,使用Swedescore进行系统性宫颈镜检查与传统方法相比,与检测CIN2+的诊断准确性略有提高。这些结果应结合两种方法之间的基线不平衡进行解读。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 在全球范围内,阴道镜检查通常由非专家进行,没有经过认证或没有常规使用阴道镜评分工具。系统性阴道镜评分工具 Swedescore 的开发旨在提高 2 级或更严重的宫颈上皮内瘤变 (CIN2+) 的检出率。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项多中心、非随机临床研究纳入了转诊接受阴道镜检查并具有可见变性区(1 型和 2 型)的女性(23-65 岁)。使用系统评分工具 Swedescore 或传统方法进行阴道镜检查。
analysis_zh.methods: 我们计算了具有 95% 置信区间的敏感性 (SN)、特异性 (SP)、阳性预测值 (PPV) 和阴性预测值 (NPV),并比较了两种方法的结果。所有女性均采集了四份宫颈活检样本。阴道镜检查人员从异常区域收集病变定向活检(目标活检),并从看似正常的区域收集或不收集非病变定向活检(随机活检)。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在纳入的 929 名女性中(Swedescore:534,传统:395),与传统方法相比,Swedescore 检测 CIN2+ 的诊断准确性略高(SN:84.7% vs. 77.8%,SP:37.3% vs. 30.9%,PPV:47.6% vs. 43.9%,NPV:78.3% vs.与传统方法相比,Swedescore 对 50 岁以上女性(92.9% vs. 62.5%)、具有高级细胞学检查的女性(92.4% vs. 83.2%)以及住院医师进行阴道镜检查(91.8% vs. 83.2%)的 CIN2+ 的敏感性显着更高。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 无论 HPV 疫苗接种 状态和筛查方法如何,Swedescore 的表现均略优于传统方法,但差异不具有统计学意义。我们的研究结果可能表明,在非专家环境中,与传统方法相比,使用 Swedescore 进行系统阴道镜检查与检测 CIN2+ 的诊断准确性稍高相关。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于在非专家环境中使用系统阴道镜评分工具来改善 CIN2+ 的检测,并可能增强 宫颈癌 筛查计划。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 应考虑两种方法之间的基线不平衡来解释这些发现。该研究是非随机的,诊断准确性的差异没有统计学意义。

papers.title: Pediatric anogenital warts: A multicenter retrospective study of clinical features, modes of transmission, and treatment patterns
papers.abstract: Abstract Anogenital warts are benign HPV-related lesions that are uncommon in children, with controversial modes of transmission and limited evidence regarding their management. We conducted a multicenter retrospective study of 63 children diagnosed with anogenital warts across 14 French hospital dermatology departments to describe their clinical characteristics, presumed modes of transmission, and treatment patterns. Anogenital warts predominantly affected young girls (43 girls [68.3%], median age at diagnosis: 4.0 years) and the perianal area; no cases of sexual abuse were identified, while hetero-inoculation was considered the most likely mode of transmission in nearly half of evaluable cases. Imiquimod was the most frequently prescribed first-line treatment (45/63, 71.4%), with a median treatment duration of 8 weeks; among 45 evaluable children, 22 (48.9%) achieved complete clearance within 8 weeks. As second-line treatment, podophyllotoxin was the most frequently prescribed therapy (n = 6), followed by imiquimod (n = 4) and cryotherapy (n = 2). Overall, treatments were well tolerated, with no serious adverse events reported. Among the 45 children who received imiquimod with evaluable safety data, local adverse events occurred in 21 (46.7%). The frequent off-label use of imiquimod underscores the need for dedicated pediatric studies and evidence-based treatment recommendations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 肛门生殖器疣是与 HPV 相关的良性病变,在儿童中并不常见,其 传播 模式存在争议,且有关其治疗的证据有限。

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Anogenital warts are benign HPV-related lesions that are uncommon in children, with controversial modes of transmission and limited evidence regarding their management. We conducted a multicenter retrospective study of 63 children diagnosed with anogenital warts across 14 French hospital dermatology departments to describe their clinical characteristics, presumed modes of transmission, and treatment patterns. Anogenital warts predominantly affected young girls (43 girls [68.3%], median age at diagnosis: 4.0 years) and the perianal area; no cases of sexual abuse were identified, while hetero-inoculation was considered the most likely mode of transmission in nearly half of evaluable cases. Imiquimod was the most frequently prescribed first-line treatment (45/63, 71.4%), with a median treatment duration of 8 weeks; among 45 evaluable children, 22 (48.9%) achieved complete clearance within 8 weeks. As second-line treatment, podophyllotoxin was the most frequently prescribed therapy (n = 6), followed by imiquimod (n = 4) and cryotherapy (n = 2). Overall, treatments were well tolerated, with no serious adverse events reported. Among the 45 children who received imiquimod with evaluable safety data, local adverse events occurred in 21 (46.7%). The frequent off-label use of imiquimod underscores the need for dedicated pediatric studies and evidence-based treatment recommendations.
