papers.title: Women's knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding human papillomavirus self-sampling in Poland: a cross-sectional online survey
papers.abstract: Objective Human papillomavirus (HPV)-based screening, including self-sampling, is increasingly recommended, but evidence on Polish women's attitudes toward self-sampling remains scarce. This study assessed knowledge of cervical cancer prevention, screening history, and attitudes toward HPV self-sampling among women in Poland. Methods An anonymous cross-sectional online survey of a 1189 adult women in Poland was conducted between May 2018 and April 2019. The primary outcome was a hypothetical preference for home self-sampling, assuming equivalent diagnostic performance. Participants also rated shame, pain, fear, discomfort, ease, and self-confidence for clinician-collected versus self-collected sampling. Results Of 1189 respondents, 523 (44.00%) stated a preference for self-sampling (67.00% of never-screened vs 36.22% of previously screened women). Previous cytology (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 0.44, 95% confidence interval [CI] “0.32, 0.62”) and regular gynaecological attendance (aOR 0.35, 95% CI “0.26, 0.46”) were associated with lower preference. Higher education was associated with higher preference (aOR 1.56, 95% CI “1.12, 2.17”). Self-sampling was rated less shameful and uncomfortable, though anticipated pain and fear were slightly higher. Conclusions In this pre-implementation sample, hypothetical interest in HPV self-sampling was considerable, particularly among women outside routine gynaecological care. Clear communication and integration of validated self-sampling within organised screening are warranted.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional online survey in Poland aimed to assess women's knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding HPV self-sampling. The study involved 1189 adult women surveyed between May 2018 and April 2019. Results showed that 44% of respondents preferred self-sampling, with a higher preference among never-screened women (67%) compared to previously screened women (36.22%). Factors associated with lower preference included previous cytology screening and regular gynaecological attendance, while higher education was linked to increased preference. papers.title: Anogenital Warts in an Elderly Male: Clinical and Public Health Perspectives
papers.abstract: Abstract: Anogenital warts (AGWS), caused by human papillomavirus (HPV), are among the most common sexually transmitted infections (STIs). Although AGWS is more commonly found in younger adults, cases in older individuals are increasingly being reported. A 76-year-old man presented with progressively enlarging brown papules in the genital area (penile base, scrotum, and left inguinal fold). Histopathological examination showed epidermal hyperplasia, papillomatosis, acanthosis, and koilocytosis. PCR examination confirmed low-risk HPV types 6 and 11. The patient reported a history of multiple sexual partners, did not use condoms during sexual intercourse, and had limited knowledge regarding STIs transmission based on a questionnaire. The patient was treated with cryotherapy and lesion excision. At the final observation, complete lesion resolution was achieved with no new lesions observed. In conclusion, this case highlights the importance of maintaining clinical awareness of AGWs in older adults. Thorough diagnostic evaluation, sexual health education, regular STIs screening, and counseling should be integrated into routine care for the elderly population. Keywords: anogenital warts, human papillomavirus, elderly, sexually transmitted infections, STIs knowledge, public health

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on anogenital warts (AGWS), which are caused by human papillomavirus (HPV), and examines their occurrence in an elderly male population. The central question is the clinical and public health significance of AGWS in older adults, particularly in relation to sexual behavior, transmission knowledge, and treatment outcomes.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a single case study of a 76-year-old man with AGWS. The evidence includes clinical presentation, histopathological findings, PCR confirmation of HPV types 6 and 11, and patient-reported sexual behavior and knowledge. The methods used are descriptive and based on direct patient evaluation and diagnostic testing.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The case study confirms that AGWS can occur in elderly individuals, with PCR identifying low-risk HPV types 6 and 11. The patient's history of multiple sexual partners and lack of condom use is associated with the condition, and treatment with cryotherapy and lesion excision resulted in complete resolution. The review concludes that AGWS should be considered in older adults and emphasizes the need for clinical awareness.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review does not report controversies or conflicting findings. However, it highlights a potential evidence gap in understanding the prevalence and transmission dynamics of AGWS in elderly populations, as well as the effectiveness of preventive measures in this demographic.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests integrating thorough diagnostic evaluation, sexual health education, and regular STI screening into routine care for the elderly. It also implies the need for further research on the epidemiology and prevention of AGWS in older adults.

analysis.summary_en: This review presents a case study of a 76-year-old man with anogenital warts (AGWS) caused by human papillomavirus (HPV) types 6 and 11. The patient had a history of multiple sexual partners and did not use condoms, contributing to his risk of infection. Clinical and histopathological findings were consistent with AGWS, and treatment with cryotherapy and lesion excision led to complete resolution. The case underscores the importance of maintaining clinical awareness of AGWS in elderly individuals and integrating diagnostic evaluation, sexual health education, and STI screening into routine care. The review highlights the need for further research on the epidemiology and prevention of AGWS in older adults, as well as the role of HPV in this demographic.

elements_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a single case study of a 76-year-old man with AGWS. The evidence includes clinical presentation, histopathological findings, PCR confirmation of HPV types 6 and 11, and patient-reported sexual behavior and knowledge. The methods used are descriptive and based on direct patient evaluation and diagnostic testing.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The case study confirms that AGWS can occur in elderly individuals, with PCR identifying low-risk HPV types 6 and 11. The patient's history of multiple sexual partners and lack of condom use is associated with the condition, and treatment with cryotherapy and lesion excision resulted in complete resolution. The review concludes that AGWS should be considered in older adults and emphasizes the need for clinical awareness.
elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review does not report controversies or conflicting findings. However, it highlights a potential evidence gap in understanding the prevalence and transmission dynamics of AGWS in elderly populations, as well as the effectiveness of preventive measures in this demographic.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests integrating thorough diagnostic evaluation, sexual health education, and regular STI screening into routine care for the elderly. It also implies the need for further research on the epidemiology and prevention of AGWS in older adults.

papers.title_zh: 老年男性肛门生殖器疣:临床和公共卫生观点
papers.source_body_en: Abstract: Anogenital warts (AGWS), caused by human papillomavirus (HPV), are among the most common sexually transmitted infections (STIs). Although AGWS is more commonly found in younger adults, cases in older individuals are increasingly being reported. A 76-year-old man presented with progressively enlarging brown papules in the genital area (penile base, scrotum, and left inguinal fold). Histopathological examination showed epidermal hyperplasia, papillomatosis, acanthosis, and koilocytosis. PCR examination confirmed low-risk HPV types 6 and 11. The patient reported a history of multiple sexual partners, did not use condoms during sexual intercourse, and had limited knowledge regarding STIs transmission based on a questionnaire. The patient was treated with cryotherapy and lesion excision. At the final observation, complete lesion resolution was achieved with no new lesions observed. In conclusion, this case highlights the importance of maintaining clinical awareness of AGWs in older adults. Thorough diagnostic evaluation, sexual health education, regular STIs screening, and counseling should be integrated into routine care for the elderly population. Keywords: anogenital warts, human papillomavirus, elderly, sexually transmitted infections, STIs knowledge, public health

papers.title: Extended genotyping of human papillomavirus and AI-assisted cervical visual evaluation for prediction of cervical precancer in nine resource-limited settings (PAVE): a cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Background Effective cervical cancer screening in resource-limited settings requires accurate, scalable, and efficient approaches. We aimed to evaluate a novel cervical screening and triage strategy that combines self-sampled human papillomavirus (HPV) testing with AI-based automated visual evaluation (AVE) for the detection of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 3 or worse (CIN3+). Methods In this cross-sectional HPV-Automated Visual Evaluation (PAVE) study we designed a new cervical screening and triage strategy for resource-limited settings that integrated HPV hierarchical extended genotyping of self-collected vaginal specimens, AVE of women with HPV, and risk stratification for efficient health-care resource management. Between Nov 14, 2022, and June 5, 2025, non-pregnant women (aged 30–49 years or aged 25–49 years for women living with HIV [WLHIV]) with no previous cervical cancer were prospectively enrolled from clinical sites in Brazil, El Salvador, Honduras, the Dominican Republic, Cambodia, Eswatini, Malawi, Nigeria, and Tanzania. Self-collected vaginal samples were tested using a new, rapid, and simplified extended genotyping HPV assay that yields four oncogenic risk groups (HPV16 [highest risk]; HPV18 or 45 [high risk]; HPV31, 33, 35, 52, or 58 [moderate risk]; and HPV39, 51, 56, 59, or 68 [lowest risk]). Women with HPV had cervical imaging and biopsy to diagnose CIN3+, which was confirmed by expert telepathology. Cervical images were captured with a mobile colposcope and classified by a previously validated deep-learning AVE algorithm as severe, indeterminate, or normal. Absolute risks of CIN3+ and 95% CIs were computed within each stratum of the combined four HPV genotype groups and the three AVE categories by HIV status. Receiver operated analysis was computed to estimate area under the curve (AUC) for the strategy. Findings Among 49 074 women with valid HPV results, 13 992 (28·5%) were HPV positive, of whom 11 169 (79·8%) attended triage. Among 7535 women with HPV and complete AVE and pathology data, 359 (5·9%) CIN3+ cases were detected among 6113 HIV-negative women and 174 (12·2%) CIN3+ cases were detected among 1422 WLHIV. CIN3+ risk increased systematically across the hierarchical HPV and AVE categories, with the highest CIN3+ risk associated with HPV16 (19·6% [95% CI 17·3–21·9]; 221 of 1129 participants) and severe AVE classification (12·7% [11·5–14·0]; 366 of 2871 participants). Risk of CIN3+ assessed using HPV genotyping and AVE assessment supported the independent utility of the tests. HPV16 with severe AVE classification was detected in 162 (31·8% [95% CI 27·8–35·9]) CIN3+ cases among 509 women without HIV and 43 (42·6% [32·9–52·2]) CIN3+ cases were among 101 WLHIV. The maximum AUC was 0·82 (95% CI 0·80–0·84) for CIN3+ diagnosed with ectocervical biopsy. Interpretation Our findings support the efficacy of integrating self-sampling, HPV extended genotyping, and AVE as a cervical cancer risk prediction strategy. Cost-effectiveness analysis will be required before implementation. Funding NCI Cancer Cures Moonshot Initiative and Médecins Sans Frontiers Foundation.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study evaluated a novel cervical screening strategy combining self-sampled HPV testing with AI-based visual evaluation (AVE) in nine resource-limited settings. The study aimed to assess the effectiveness of integrating HPV extended genotyping and AVE for detecting cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 3 or worse (CIN3+). HPV testing identified four oncogenic risk groups, while AVE classified cervical images as severe, indeterminate, or normal. Among 49,074 women, 28.5% were HPV positive, with 5.9% of HIV-negative women and 12.2% of women living with HIV (WLHIV) diagnosed with CIN3+. The highest CIN3+ risk was associated with HPV16 and severe AVE classification. The results support the potential of this integrated approach for cervical cancer risk prediction, though further cost-effectiveness analysis is needed before implementation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 背景 在资源有限的环境中进行有效的 宫颈癌 筛选需要准确、可扩展且高效的方法。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这项横断面 HPV 自动视觉评估 (PAVE) 研究中,于 11 月 14 日期间前瞻性地从巴西、萨尔瓦多、洪都拉斯、多米尼加共和国、柬埔寨、斯威士兰、马拉维、尼日利亚和坦桑尼亚的临床中心招募了既往没有 宫颈癌 的非孕妇(年龄为 30-49 岁,或年龄为 25-49 岁的 HIV 感染者 [WLHIV])。2022年和2025年6月5日。
elements_zh.methods: 使用新的、快速且简化的扩展基因分型 HPV 检测对自行收集的阴道样本进行测试,该检测可产生四个致癌风险组(HPV16 [最高风险];HPV18 或 45 [高风险];HPV31、33、35、52 或 58 [中等风险];以及 HPV39、51、56、59 或 68 [最低风险])。使用移动阴道镜拍摄宫颈图像,并通过先前验证的深度学习 AVE 算法将其分类为严重、不确定或正常。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 49 074 名具有有效 HPV 结果的女性中,13 992 名 (28·5%) HPV 阳性,其中 11 169 名 (79·8%) 接受了分诊。在 7535 名患有 HPV 且具有完整 AVE 和病理数据的女性中,6113 名 HIV 阴性女性中检测到 359 例 (5·9%) CIN3+ 病例,在 1422 名 WLHIV 中检测到 174 例 (12·2%) CIN3+ 病例。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 解释 我们的研究结果支持整合自我采样、HPV 扩展基因分型和 AVE 作为 宫颈癌 风险预测策略的有效性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,将 HPV 扩展基因分型与基于人工智能的视觉评估相结合可以改善资源有限环境中的 宫颈癌 风险预测,支持开发可扩展且高效的筛查策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告研究设计的具体局限性。

papers.title: Implications of Alpha and Beta Human Papillomaviruses Infection in the Oral Microbiome from Mexican Subjects Living with HIV
papers.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection and oral microbiota alterations have been independently associated with oral disease in people living with HIV (PLHIV). However, the relationship between alpha-HPV (α-HPV), beta-HPV (β-HPV), and the oral microbiome remains poorly understood. This cross-sectional study aimed to describe the association between oral HPV infection and the oral and oropharyngeal microbiome in Mexican PLHIV with sustained virologic control and immune reconstitution. Oral and oropharyngeal samples were obtained by rinsing and gargling, and participants were classified into HPV-negative, α-HPV (PGMY primers), and β-HPV (FAP primers) groups. The V3–V4 region of the 16S rRNA gene was sequenced using the Illumina MiSeq platform. A total of 65 participants were included in the final analysis: 19 HPV-negative, 16 -α-HPV positive (PGMY primers), and β-HPV positive (FAP primers). Bacterial Alpha diversity of the oral microbiome was significantly higher in both α-HPV- positive and β-HPV positive groups than in the HPV-negative group, with the highest diversity observed in the α-HPV positive group. The α-HPV group also showed a higher Fusobacteriota/Bacteroidota ratio and enrichment of Fusobacteriota-related taxa. In addition, predicted functional analysis showed enrichment of pathways related to lysine and pyruvate fermentation to butyrate in the α-HPV(PGMY primers) group. These findings suggest that α- and β-HPV infections may be associated with different oral microbial ecosystems in PLHIV.

papers.title: Human Papillomavirus Prevalence in Seminal Tract Among the Patients with Testicular Tumor; Dose HPV Infection Have an Etiological Role for the Development of Testicular Tumor?
papers.abstract: This study investigated the prevalence, genotypes, and tissue localization of human papillomavirus (HPV)-DNA in testicular tumor including epididymis and spermatic cord specimens from 116 Japanese patients who underwent radical inguinal orchiectomy. Formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tissues were analyzed by nested polymerase chain reaction (PCR), followed by sequencing-based HPV genotyping. HPV-DNA localization was assessed by in situ hybridization (ISH), and E6/E7 mRNA ISH was performed in HPV-positive specimens. HPV-DNA was detected in three patients (3/116, 2.6%), including one testicular tumor specimen (1/116, 0.9%) and two spermatic cord specimens (2/116, 1.7%). All HPV-positive specimens contained HPV16-DNA. HPV-DNA ISH signals were observed in seminoma cells in one testicular specimen and in the vas deferens epithelium in one spermatic cord specimen. On the other hand, ISH signals were not present in epididymis tissue in the HPV-positive testicular tumor tissue, suggesting that HPV-DNA detection rate of epididymis was 0%. E6/E7 mRNA signals were not detected in any HPV-positive specimen. These findings demonstrate that HPV16-DNA was surely present in testicular tumor and the vas deferens epithelium. However we could not provide evidence of transcriptionally active HPV oncogenes, and could not establish a causal role in testicular tumorigenesis.

papers.title_zh: 睾丸肿瘤患者精道中的人乳头瘤病毒 患病率 HPV 感染对睾丸肿瘤的发生有一定的病因作用吗?
papers.source_body_en: This study investigated the prevalence, genotypes, and tissue localization of human papillomavirus (HPV)-DNA in testicular tumor including epididymis and spermatic cord specimens from 116 Japanese patients who underwent radical inguinal orchiectomy. Formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tissues were analyzed by nested polymerase chain reaction (PCR), followed by sequencing-based HPV genotyping. HPV-DNA localization was assessed by in situ hybridization (ISH), and E6/E7 mRNA ISH was performed in HPV-positive specimens. HPV-DNA was detected in three patients (3/116, 2.6%), including one testicular tumor specimen (1/116, 0.9%) and two spermatic cord specimens (2/116, 1.7%). All HPV-positive specimens contained HPV16-DNA. HPV-DNA ISH signals were observed in seminoma cells in one testicular specimen and in the vas deferens epithelium in one spermatic cord specimen. On the other hand, ISH signals were not present in epididymis tissue in the HPV-positive testicular tumor tissue, suggesting that HPV-DNA detection rate of epididymis was 0%. E6/E7 mRNA signals were not detected in any HPV-positive specimen. These findings demonstrate that HPV16-DNA was surely present in testicular tumor and the vas deferens epithelium. However we could not provide evidence of transcriptionally active HPV oncogenes, and could not establish a causal role in testicular tumorigenesis.

papers.title: Anatomical Distribution of Human Papillomavirus Infection in the Lower Urinary Tract of Men with Bladder Cancer Undergoing Radical Cystectomy
papers.abstract: We investigated the anatomical distribution of human papillomavirus (HPV) infection in the lower urinary tract of men with bladder cancer undergoing radical cystectomy. In total, 79 anterior urethral samples, 99 prostatic urethral specimens, 74 bladder tumor specimens, and 87 non-tumor bladder specimens were collected from 102 patients. After DNA extraction from each formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue specimen, HPV-DNA was examined by nested polymerase chain reaction, and HPV genotypes were determined by Sanger sequencing. In situ hybridization (ISH) was used to localize HPV-DNA in positive samples, and E6/E7 mRNA ISH was performed to assess transcriptional activity. HPV-DNA was detected at any site in 16 (15.7%) of 102 patients, with site-specific detection rates of 8.0% (7/87) in non-tumor bladder mucosa, 5.1% (4/79) in the anterior urethra, 4.1% (3/74) in bladder tumor tissue, and 4.0% (4/99) in the prostatic urethra. HPV16 was detected in 11 samples, and HPV18 in 7 samples. HPV-DNA ISH signals were observed in 12 (66.7%) of 18 HPV-positive specimens, and E6/E7 mRNA signals were present in 2 of 18 specimens. HPV-DNA was detected at various sites of the lower urinary tract. E6/E7 mRNA expression in a bladder cancer specimen warrants further research on the biological relevance of HR-HPV infection.

papers.title: HPV-Associated Non-Salivary Adenocarcinoma of the Oropharynx
papers.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated non-salivary adenocarcinoma of the oropharynx is exceptionally rare and poorly defined. We report a multi-institutional series of 12 cases from 6 tertiary centers. Histologic, immunohistochemical, HPV testing, molecular, and follow-up data were reviewed. Among 11 patients with available sex data, all were men; the median age was 62 years (range: 46 to 70 y). The cohort comprised 9 primary oropharyngeal adenocarcinomas and 3 metastatic adenocarcinomas, including a right neck metastasis of presumed oropharyngeal origin and 2 distant metastases in patients with previously documented HPV-associated oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma. Primary sites included the palatine tonsil or tonsil-palate region (n=7), base of tongue (n=1), and oropharynx, not otherwise specified (n=1). Among cases with available T-category, 5 of 6 were T3/T4. All tumors showed high-grade adenocarcinoma morphology without a recognizable squamous component, with infiltrative glandular, ductal, or cribriform architecture. Diffuse p16 expression was present in all cases, and high-risk HPV was confirmed by polymerase chain reaction or in situ hybridization. p40 was negative in the tumor cell population in cases 1 to 6, 8, 9, 11, and 12, whereas case 7 showed p40 and CK5/6 expression confined to abluminal cells. Molecular profiling in 2 cases identified alterations or variants involving PIK3CA and PIK3R1 . Follow-up in 6 patients with primary tumors showed distant metastases in 3 and disease-specific death in 1. HPV-associated nonsalivary adenocarcinoma of the oropharynx is a diagnostically challenging tumor that expands the morphologic spectrum of HPV-related oropharyngeal carcinoma. Recognition requires exclusion of salivary-type and metastatic adenocarcinoma and confirmation of HPV association.

analysis.summary_en: This review article focuses on HPV-associated non-salivary adenocarcinoma of the oropharynx, a rare and poorly defined condition. The study reports on a multi-institutional series of 12 cases from 6 tertiary centers, highlighting the demographic and clinical characteristics of the cohort. All tumors exhibited high-grade adenocarcinoma morphology without a squamous component, and diffuse p16 expression was observed in all cases, with high-risk HPV confirmed by PCR or in situ hybridization. The article emphasizes the diagnostic challenges of this condition, noting the need to exclude salivary-type and metastatic adenocarcinomas. Follow-up data showed distant metastases in 3 of 6 patients and one disease-specific death. Molecular profiling identified PIK3CA and PIK3R1 alterations in two cases. The findings suggest that this tumor type expands the morphologic spectrum of HPV-related oropharyngeal cancers and underscores the importance of accurate diagnosis and HPV confirmation.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 相关的口咽非唾液腺癌极为罕见且定义不明确。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 我们报告了来自 6 个三级中心的 12 例多机构系列病例。对组织学、免疫组织化学、HPV 检测、分子和随访数据进行了审查。在有可用性别数据的 11 名患者中,全部为男性;中位年龄为 62 岁(范围:46 岁至 70 岁)。队列研究 包括 9 例原发性口咽腺癌和 3 例转移性腺癌,其中包括假定口咽起源的右颈转移瘤和先前记录的 HPV 相关口咽鳞状细胞癌患者的 2 例远处转移瘤。主要部位包括腭扁桃体或扁桃体腭区 (n=7)、舌根 (n=1) 和口咽,未另有说明 (n=1)。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 所有肿瘤均显示高级腺癌形态,没有可识别的鳞状成分,具有浸润性腺体、导管或筛状结构。所有病例均存在弥漫性p16表达,并通过聚合酶链式反应或原位杂交证实了高危型HPV。对 6 名原发性肿瘤患者的随访显示,3 名患者出现远处转移,1 名患者出现疾病特异性死亡。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 在具有 T 类别的病例中,6 例中有 5 例为 T3/T4。在病例 1 至 6、8、9、11 和 12 中,p40 在肿瘤细胞群中呈阴性,而病例 7 显示 p40 和 CK5/6 表达仅限于近腔细胞。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: HPV 相关的口咽非唾液腺癌是一种诊断上具有挑战性的肿瘤,它扩大了 HPV 相关口咽癌的形态谱。识别需要排除唾液型和转移性腺癌并确认 HPV 相关性。

papers.title: Neoadjuvant Nivolumab plus Carboplatin and Paclitaxel in Patients with Locally Advanced Resectable Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck: A Phase II, Single-Arm Trial.
papers.abstract: Abstract Purpose: In locally advanced resectable squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck (SCCHN), patients treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy with major pathologic response (MPR) or pathologic complete response (pCR) have overall survival (OS) rates superior to those of patients with poorer pathologic responses. To improve efficacy, we added the PD-1 inhibitor nivolumab to neoadjuvant chemotherapy and evaluated the combination. Patients and Methods: In this single-arm, open-label phase II trial, patients with newly diagnosed stage III to IV human papillomavirus (HPV)–negative SCCHN in the oral cavity, oropharynx, hypopharynx, and larynx or stage II to III HPV-positive oropharyngeal SCCHN received neoadjuvant carboplatin and paclitaxel (6 weeks) plus nivolumab (every other week), followed by surgery and adjuvant radiotherapy ± chemotherapy. The primary endpoint was pCR at the primary site. Results: Thirty-four patients were enrolled and received neoadjuvant therapy. Thirty-three patients received surgery (R0 resection = 100%). Disease sites included the oral cavity (79%), oropharynx (12%), hypopharynx (6%), and larynx (3%). Twenty-eight (85%) patients had stage IVA disease. The median postsurgical follow-up was 35.3 months. Fourteen (41%) patients had grade 3/4 treatment-related adverse events. Twenty-seven (82%) patients completed all cycles of neoadjuvant therapy. Twenty-four (73%) patients had at least an MPR at the primary site, and 15 (45%) had a pCR. In an unplanned analysis at 3 years, recurrence-free survival and OS were 74% and 83%, respectively. Conclusions: This phase II trial of neoadjuvant nivolumab plus carboplatin and paclitaxel in previously untreated, locally advanced, resectable SCCHN was well tolerated and reached its primary endpoint of pCR at the primary site. A phase III confirmatory study is warranted in advanced-stage, resectable HPV-negative SCCHN. See related commentary by Anderson and Sikora, p.

analysis.research_question_and_background: In locally advanced resectable squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck (SCCHN), patients treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy with major pathologic response (MPR) or pathologic complete response (pCR) have overall survival (OS) rates superior to those of patients with poorer pathologic responses.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This single-arm, open-label phase II trial evaluated neoadjuvant nivolumab plus carboplatin and paclitaxel in patients with newly diagnosed stage III to IV human papillomavirus (HPV)–negative SCCHN in the oral cavity, oropharynx, hypopharynx, and larynx or stage II to III HPV-positive oropharyngeal SCCHN.
analysis.methods: Patients received neoadjuvant carboplatin and paclitaxel (6 weeks) plus nivolumab (every other week), followed by surgery and adjuvant radiotherapy ± chemotherapy. The primary endpoint was pCR at the primary site.
analysis.main_results: Thirty-four patients were enrolled and received neoadjuvant therapy. Twenty-four (73%) patients had at least an MPR at the primary site, and 15 (45%) had a pCR. Twenty-seven (82%) patients completed all cycles of neoadjuvant therapy.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrated that the combination of neoadjuvant nivolumab with carboplatin and paclitaxel achieved a significant pCR rate, which is a novel finding in the treatment of locally advanced resectable SCCHN.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that this combination therapy could improve outcomes for patients with HPV-negative SCCHN, potentially informing future treatment strategies and clinical trials.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was a single-arm trial with no comparator group, which limits the ability to draw definitive conclusions about the efficacy of the treatment.

analysis.summary_en: This phase II trial investigated the efficacy of neoadjuvant nivolumab combined with carboplatin and paclitaxel in patients with locally advanced resectable squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck (SCCHN). The study aimed to improve treatment outcomes by leveraging the PD-1 inhibitor nivolumab. Thirty-four patients were enrolled, with 33 undergoing surgery. The primary endpoint, pathologic complete response (pCR), was achieved in 15 patients (45%). Additionally, 24 patients (73%) had at least a major pathologic response (MPR). The trial was well tolerated, with 41% of patients experiencing grade 3/4 treatment-related adverse events. These results suggest that the combination therapy may offer improved outcomes for patients with HPV-negative SCCHN, warranting further investigation in a phase III trial. However, the lack of a comparator group limits the strength of the evidence.

elements_zh.methods: 患者接受新辅助卡铂和紫杉醇(6周)加纳武单抗(每隔一周),然后接受手术和辅助放疗±化疗。主要终点是原发部位的 pCR。
elements_zh.main_results: Thirty-four patients were enrolled and received neoadjuvant therapy. Twenty-four (73%) patients had at least an MPR at the primary site, and 15 (45%) had a pCR. Twenty-seven (82%) patients completed all cycles of neoadjuvant therapy.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,新辅助纳武单抗联合卡铂和紫杉醇实现了显着的 pCR 率,这是 治疗 局部晚期可切除 SCCHN 的新发现。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,这种联合疗法可以改善 HPV 阴性 SCCHN 患者的预后,可能为未来的 治疗 策略和临床试验提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是一项单臂试验,没有比较组,这限制了对 治疗 疗效得出明确结论的能力。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: In locally advanced resectable squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck (SCCHN), patients treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy with major pathologic response (MPR) or pathologic complete response (pCR) have overall survival (OS) rates superior to those of patients with poorer pathologic responses.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This single-arm, open-label phase II trial evaluated neoadjuvant nivolumab plus carboplatin and paclitaxel in patients with newly diagnosed stage III to IV human papillomavirus (HPV)–negative SCCHN in the oral cavity, oropharynx, hypopharynx, and larynx or stage II to III HPV-positive oropharyngeal SCCHN.
analysis_en.methods: Patients received neoadjuvant carboplatin and paclitaxel (6 weeks) plus nivolumab (every other week), followed by surgery and adjuvant radiotherapy ± chemotherapy. The primary endpoint was pCR at the primary site.
analysis_en.main_results: Thirty-four patients were enrolled and received neoadjuvant therapy. Twenty-four (73%) patients had at least an MPR at the primary site, and 15 (45%) had a pCR. Twenty-seven (82%) patients completed all cycles of neoadjuvant therapy.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrated that the combination of neoadjuvant nivolumab with carboplatin and paclitaxel achieved a significant pCR rate, which is a novel finding in the treatment of locally advanced resectable SCCHN.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that this combination therapy could improve outcomes for patients with HPV-negative SCCHN, potentially informing future treatment strategies and clinical trials.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was a single-arm trial with no comparator group, which limits the ability to draw definitive conclusions about the efficacy of the treatment.

papers.title_zh: 新辅助纳武单抗联合卡铂和紫杉醇治疗局部晚期可切除头颈鳞状细胞癌患者:一项 II 期单臂试验。
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Purpose: In locally advanced resectable squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck (SCCHN), patients treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy with major pathologic response (MPR) or pathologic complete response (pCR) have overall survival (OS) rates superior to those of patients with poorer pathologic responses. To improve efficacy, we added the PD-1 inhibitor nivolumab to neoadjuvant chemotherapy and evaluated the combination. Patients and Methods: In this single-arm, open-label phase II trial, patients with newly diagnosed stage III to IV human papillomavirus (HPV)–negative SCCHN in the oral cavity, oropharynx, hypopharynx, and larynx or stage II to III HPV-positive oropharyngeal SCCHN received neoadjuvant carboplatin and paclitaxel (6 weeks) plus nivolumab (every other week), followed by surgery and adjuvant radiotherapy ± chemotherapy. The primary endpoint was pCR at the primary site. Results: Thirty-four patients were enrolled and received neoadjuvant therapy. Thirty-three patients received surgery (R0 resection = 100%). Disease sites included the oral cavity (79%), oropharynx (12%), hypopharynx (6%), and larynx (3%). Twenty-eight (85%) patients had stage IVA disease. The median postsurgical follow-up was 35.3 months. Fourteen (41%) patients had grade 3/4 treatment-related adverse events. Twenty-seven (82%) patients completed all cycles of neoadjuvant therapy. Twenty-four (73%) patients had at least an MPR at the primary site, and 15 (45%) had a pCR. In an unplanned analysis at 3 years, recurrence-free survival and OS were 74% and 83%, respectively. Conclusions: This phase II trial of neoadjuvant nivolumab plus carboplatin and paclitaxel in previously untreated, locally advanced, resectable SCCHN was well tolerated and reached its primary endpoint of pCR at the primary site. A phase III confirmatory study is warranted in advanced-stage, resectable HPV-negative SCCHN. See related commentary by Anderson and Sikora, p.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 目的:在局部晚期可切除的头颈部鳞状细胞癌(SCCHN)患者中,接受新辅助化疗并获得主要病理反应(MPR)或病理完全反应(pCR)的患者,其总体生存率(OS)优于病理反应较差的患者。为了提高疗效,我们向新辅助化疗中加入了PD-1抑制剂纳武利尤单抗,并评估了联合治疗的效果。患者和方法:本项单臂、开放标签II期试验纳入了新诊断的口腔、口咽、下咽和喉部的局部晚期HPV阴性SCCHN患者,或口咽部II至III期HPV阳性SCCHN患者。患者接受新辅助治疗(卡铂和紫杉醇,6周)联合纳武利尤单抗(每两周一次),随后进行手术和辅助放疗±化疗。主要终点是原发部位的pCR。结果:共纳入34名患者并接受新辅助治疗。33名患者接受了手术(R0切除率为100%)。疾病部位包括口腔(79%)、口咽(12%)、下咽(6%)和喉部(3%)。28名(85%)患者为IV期疾病。术后随访中位数为35.3个月。14名(41%)患者出现3/4级人乳头瘤病毒相关不良事件。27名(82%)患者完成了所有新辅助治疗周期。24名(73%)患者在原发部位至少达到MPR,其中15名(45%)达到pCR。在一项未计划的3年分析中,无病生存率和总体生存率分别为74%和83%。结论:本项II期试验评估了未接受过治疗的局部晚期可切除SCCHN患者的新辅助纳武利尤单抗联合卡铂和紫杉醇治疗,该治疗方案耐受性良好,并达到了原发部位pCR的主要终点。需要在晚期、可切除的HPV阴性SCCHN患者中开展III期确认性研究。参见Anderson和Sikora的评论文章,第p页。

papers.title: Barriers limiting access to follow-up care after HPV screening for cervical cancer in global settings: A systematic review
papers.abstract: Abstract Follow-up care after a positive human papillomavirus (HPV) screening result is essential for cervical cancer prevention, yet many individuals do not complete diagnostic evaluation or treatment. We conducted a systematic review to synthesize barriers to follow-up care after a positive HPV screening result across diverse international settings. The protocol was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251062691). We searched MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science for English language studies published from 2015 to 2025. Two reviewers independently screened studies, and findings were narratively synthesized. Fifteen studies met inclusion criteria, and were conducted across 12 locations in Africa, Europe, North America, and South America. Five barrier groups emerged: health system barriers (lack of local treatment, long wait times, limited follow-up capacity), knowledge and communication barriers (confusion about HPV results and next steps), psychological and emotional barriers (fear of treatment, stigma surrounding HPV, distrust in medical systems), social and relational barriers (partner influence, gender roles, lack of peer support), and structural and logistical barriers (transportation, costs, work conflicts). Across settings, missed follow-up after positive HPV screening appeared more strongly linked to health-system and structural barriers than lack of motivation. Strengthening referral pathways, patient tracking systems, communication of results, navigation support, and timely treatment access may improve follow-up completion and enhance the effectiveness of HPV-based screening programs.

papers.title: Decisional needs for anal cancer screening among high-risk populations: A systematic review.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: This systematic review aimed to identify and synthesize decisional needs (i.e., factors that adversely affect decision quality) of anal cancer screening among high-risk populations. METHODS: MEDLINE, Embase, CINAHL, and PsycINFO were searched from inception years (1946, 1974, 1937, and 1806 respectively) to December 14, 2025. Studies examining anal cancer screening decisional needs among high-risk populations identified by the International Anal Neoplasia Society were eligible. Two reviewers conducted title/abstract, full-text screening and data extraction independently. Study quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool. Directed content analysis was used to synthesize decisional needs by the Ottawa Decision Support Framework. RESULTS: Twenty-two studies involving 6522 participants were included. Twelve cross-sectional and 10 qualitative studies were conducted in the United States, Canada, Australia, and France. The most reported decisional needs were inadequate knowledge (19 studies), inadequate support or resources (15 studies), and unrealistic expectations regarding personal susceptibility to anal cancer or human papillomavirus (seven studies). Knowledge gaps concerned anal cancer risk, screening procedures, and results interpretation. Support needs included insufficient guidance, emotional concerns and limited access. CONCLUSIONS: High-risk populations lack the information and support for anal cancer screening decisions. Implementation should combine tailored risk communication, non-stigmatizing discussion, values clarification, and clear follow-up pathways.

papers.title_zh: 高危人群肛门癌筛查的决策需求:系统评价。
papers.source_body_en: OBJECTIVE: This systematic review aimed to identify and synthesize decisional needs (i.e., factors that adversely affect decision quality) of anal cancer screening among high-risk populations. METHODS: MEDLINE, Embase, CINAHL, and PsycINFO were searched from inception years (1946, 1974, 1937, and 1806 respectively) to December 14, 2025. Studies examining anal cancer screening decisional needs among high-risk populations identified by the International Anal Neoplasia Society were eligible. Two reviewers conducted title/abstract, full-text screening and data extraction independently. Study quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool. Directed content analysis was used to synthesize decisional needs by the Ottawa Decision Support Framework. RESULTS: Twenty-two studies involving 6522 participants were included. Twelve cross-sectional and 10 qualitative studies were conducted in the United States, Canada, Australia, and France. The most reported decisional needs were inadequate knowledge (19 studies), inadequate support or resources (15 studies), and unrealistic expectations regarding personal susceptibility to anal cancer or human papillomavirus (seven studies). Knowledge gaps concerned anal cancer risk, screening procedures, and results interpretation. Support needs included insufficient guidance, emotional concerns and limited access. CONCLUSIONS: High-risk populations lack the information and support for anal cancer screening decisions. Implementation should combine tailored risk communication, non-stigmatizing discussion, values clarification, and clear follow-up pathways.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的:本系统评价旨在确定和综合高危人群肛门癌筛查的决策需求(即对决策质量产生不利影响的因素)。方法:对 MEDLINE、Embase、CINAHL 和 PsycINFO 进行检索,检索时间为创建年份(分别为 1946 年、1974 年、1937 年和 1806 年)至 2025 年 12 月 14 日。检查国际肛门肿瘤协会确定的高危人群中肛门癌筛查决策需求的研究符合条件。两名审稿人独立进行标题/摘要、全文筛选和数据提取。使用混合方法评估工具评估研究质量。渥太华决策支持框架使用定向内容分析来综合决策需求。结果:纳入了 22 项研究,涉及 6522 名参与者。在美国、加拿大、澳大利亚和法国进行了 12 项横断面研究和 10 项定性研究。报告最多的决策需求是知识不足(19 项研究)、支持或资源不足(15 项研究)以及对个人对肛门癌或 人乳头瘤病毒 易感性的不切实际的期望(7 项研究)。知识差距涉及肛门癌风险、筛查程序和结果解释。支持需求包括指导不足、情感担忧和访问受限。结论:高危人群缺乏肛门癌筛查决策的信息和支持。实施应结合量身定制的风险沟通、非污名化的讨论、价值观澄清和明确的后续路径。

papers.title: Pre-implementation assessment of upstream domains on the uptake of HPV self-sampling in safety-net settings: a scoping review
papers.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) screening can be used as an early detector for cervical cancer. The newly US Food and Drug Administration-approved HPV self-sampling tests can be used by safety net practices in the USA to help mitigate the current screening disparities seen in patients. As patient acceptability and capability have already been established, this scoping review synthesizes the barriers and facilitators of implementing HPV self-sampling from the perspective of safety net providers and leadership, and the upstream factors not yet explored in current research. Following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, a literature search was conducted exploring peer-reviewed publications and grey literature to establish the current landscape of HPV self-sampling. Findings were organized using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research. From the 57 works included, it was found that safety net practices are capable of implementing HPV self-sampling by utilizing current workflows and team members. However, outer setting guidelines and policies heavily influence the implementation process, likely causing a delay in uptake by safety net practices. Recent guideline endorsements and forthcoming insurance coverage address several of these barriers, making post-approval implementation research in safety net settings an urgent priority.

papers.title_original: Pre-implementation assessment of upstream domains on the uptake of HPV self-sampling in safety-net settings: a scoping review

analysis.scope_and_question: This scoping review examines the barriers and facilitators of implementing HPV self-sampling in safety-net settings, focusing on upstream factors that influence its uptake. The review is centered on HPV types and HPV-associated diseases, particularly cervical cancer, and explores the role of provider and leadership perspectives in implementation.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review followed PRISMA-ScR guidelines, conducting a literature search across peer-reviewed publications and grey literature. The findings were organized using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research to identify key implementation factors.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Safety net practices are capable of implementing HPV self-sampling using existing workflows and team members. However, external guidelines and policies significantly influence the implementation process, potentially delaying its adoption in these settings.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is limited evidence on the specific upstream factors affecting HPV self-sampling implementation in safety-net settings. The review highlights the need for further research to address these gaps and understand how policy changes can accelerate uptake.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Post-approval implementation research in safety-net settings is an urgent priority, particularly as recent guideline endorsements and potential insurance coverage may help overcome existing barriers. This research should focus on understanding the impact of policy and external guidelines on implementation success.

analysis.summary_en: This scoping review evaluates the barriers and facilitators of implementing HPV self-sampling in safety-net settings, emphasizing upstream factors that influence its adoption. The review identifies that safety-net practices can integrate HPV self-sampling into existing workflows, but external guidelines and policies significantly affect implementation timelines. While patient acceptability and capability are established, the review underscores the need for targeted research to address implementation challenges and leverage recent guideline endorsements and insurance coverage. The findings highlight the importance of understanding how policy changes can support the uptake of HPV self-sampling in underserved populations.

analysis_en.scope_and_question: This scoping review examines the barriers and facilitators of implementing HPV self-sampling in safety-net settings, focusing on upstream factors that influence its uptake. The review is centered on HPV types and HPV-associated diseases, particularly cervical cancer, and explores the role of provider and leadership perspectives in implementation.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review followed PRISMA-ScR guidelines, conducting a literature search across peer-reviewed publications and grey literature. The findings were organized using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research to identify key implementation factors.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Safety net practices are capable of implementing HPV self-sampling using existing workflows and team members. However, external guidelines and policies significantly influence the implementation process, potentially delaying its adoption in these settings.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is limited evidence on the specific upstream factors affecting HPV self-sampling implementation in safety-net settings. The review highlights the need for further research to address these gaps and understand how policy changes can accelerate uptake.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: Post-approval implementation research in safety-net settings is an urgent priority, particularly as recent guideline endorsements and potential insurance coverage may help overcome existing barriers. This research should focus on understanding the impact of policy and external guidelines on implementation success.

papers.title_zh: 对安全网环境中 HPV 自我采样情况上游领域的实施前评估:范围界定审查
papers.source_body_en: Human papillomavirus (HPV) screening can be used as an early detector for cervical cancer. The newly US Food and Drug Administration-approved HPV self-sampling tests can be used by safety net practices in the USA to help mitigate the current screening disparities seen in patients. As patient acceptability and capability have already been established, this scoping review synthesizes the barriers and facilitators of implementing HPV self-sampling from the perspective of safety net providers and leadership, and the upstream factors not yet explored in current research. Following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, a literature search was conducted exploring peer-reviewed publications and grey literature to establish the current landscape of HPV self-sampling. Findings were organized using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research. From the 57 works included, it was found that safety net practices are capable of implementing HPV self-sampling by utilizing current workflows and team members. However, outer setting guidelines and policies heavily influence the implementation process, likely causing a delay in uptake by safety net practices. Recent guideline endorsements and forthcoming insurance coverage address several of these barriers, making post-approval implementation research in safety net settings an urgent priority.

papers.title: Productive or Transforming? How Epithelial Compartmentalization of HPV DNA and E6/E7 Transcripts Shapes Cervical Screening Assay Performance.
papers.abstract: The human papillomavirus (HPV) life cycle is linked to epithelial cell differentiation, with viral genome amplification, E6/E7 transcription, and virion assembly spatially compartmentalized within the cervical epithelium. This organization is disrupted in transforming lesions. These fundamental observations determine what 'bulk' nucleic acid amplification tests (NAATs) of cervical exfoliates allow us to establish. DNA-based assays sensitively report high-risk HPV genome presence, which includes transient infections and virus particles. RNA-based assays target the E6/E7 transcripts in transcriptionally active disease, which accounts for their slightly higher clinical specificity for high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions. No single assay defines both viral presence and disease significance, however. Cytology, p16/Ki-67 dual stain, extended genotyping and host-cell methylation interrogate complementary axes of risk with strong biological rationale. The loss of spatial information that limits bulk NAAT approaches matters most in mixed-grade lesions and immunocompromised populations. Emerging spatial methods, AI-assisted cytology and cervical cell-lifts offer recovery of biological resolution.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how the spatial compartmentalization of HPV DNA and E6/E7 transcripts within cervical epithelial cells influences the performance of cervical screening assays.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research focused on the organization of HPV within cervical epithelium, examining its disruption in transforming lesions and its implications for diagnostic methods.
analysis.methods: The study analyzed the spatial distribution of HPV DNA and E6/E7 transcripts, comparing DNA-based assays that detect viral presence with RNA-based assays that target transcriptionally active disease.
analysis.main_results: DNA-based assays sensitively report high-risk HPV genome presence, including transient infections and virus particles, while RNA-based assays have slightly higher clinical specificity for high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the spatial organization of HPV within the epithelium determines the effectiveness of bulk nucleic acid amplification tests, highlighting the need for complementary approaches to capture biological resolution.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the development of more accurate cervical screening assays by emphasizing the importance of spatial information in assessing HPV-related disease risk.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges the loss of spatial information in bulk NAAT approaches, which is most critical in mixed-grade lesions and immunocompromised populations, suggesting moderate evidence strength due to its abstract-only nature.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores how the spatial compartmentalization of human papillomavirus (HPV) DNA and E6/E7 transcripts within cervical epithelial cells affects the performance of cervical screening assays. It highlights that DNA-based assays are sensitive to HPV presence, including transient infections, while RNA-based assays offer higher specificity for high-grade lesions. The authors emphasize the importance of spatial information in understanding HPV's role in disease, suggesting that complementary methods like cytology, p16/Ki-67 dual stain, and cell-lifts can improve diagnostic accuracy. The study notes limitations in bulk NAAT approaches, particularly in mixed-grade lesions and immunocompromised individuals, and suggests that emerging spatial methods and AI-assisted cytology may recover lost biological resolution. The evidence is abstract-only, providing moderate confidence in its conclusions.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究的重点是宫颈上皮内 HPV 的组织,检查其对病变转化的破坏及其对诊断方法的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究分析了 HPV DNA 和 E6/E7 转录本的空间分布,将检测病毒存在的基于 DNA 的检测与针对转录活跃疾病的基于 RNA 的检测进行了比较。
elements_zh.main_results: 基于 DNA 的检测可灵敏地报告 高危型HPV 基因组 的存在,包括短暂感染和病毒颗粒,而基于 RNA 的检测对高级鳞状上皮内病变具有稍高的临床特异性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,上皮内 HPV 的空间组织决定了批量核酸扩增测试的有效性,强调需要补充方法来捕获生物学分辨率。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了空间信息在评估 HPV 相关疾病风险中的重要性,为更准确的宫颈筛查测定的开发提供了信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究承认批量 NAAT 方法会丢失空间信息,这在混合级别病变和免疫功能低下人群中最为关键,这表明由于其仅抽象的性质,证据强度适中。

papers.title_zh: 生产力还是变革? HPV DNA 和 E6/E7 转录本的上皮区室化如何影响宫颈筛查检测性能。
papers.source_body_en: The human papillomavirus (HPV) life cycle is linked to epithelial cell differentiation, with viral genome amplification, E6/E7 transcription, and virion assembly spatially compartmentalized within the cervical epithelium. This organization is disrupted in transforming lesions. These fundamental observations determine what 'bulk' nucleic acid amplification tests (NAATs) of cervical exfoliates allow us to establish. DNA-based assays sensitively report high-risk HPV genome presence, which includes transient infections and virus particles. RNA-based assays target the E6/E7 transcripts in transcriptionally active disease, which accounts for their slightly higher clinical specificity for high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions. No single assay defines both viral presence and disease significance, however. Cytology, p16/Ki-67 dual stain, extended genotyping and host-cell methylation interrogate complementary axes of risk with strong biological rationale. The loss of spatial information that limits bulk NAAT approaches matters most in mixed-grade lesions and immunocompromised populations. Emerging spatial methods, AI-assisted cytology and cervical cell-lifts offer recovery of biological resolution.

papers.title: Competing Endogenous Ribonucleic Acid Networks in Cervical Cancer: Mechanisms and Clinical Implications.
papers.abstract: Cervical cancer (CC) remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality among women, with persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) representing its primary etiological factor. Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs), circular RNAs (circRNAs), and pseudogenes can function as competing endogenous RNAs (ceRNAs) by competing with messenger RNAs (mRNAs) for binding to microRNAs (miRNAs), thereby reducing miRNA-mediated repression of target mRNAs. This review categorizes the ceRNA axes reported in CC as oncogenic or tumor-suppressive and examines their convergence on major signaling pathways, including Wnt/β-catenin, phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K)/Akt, mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK), Hippo, and Notch, together with the strength of the supporting evidence. The roles of these networks in prognosis, resistance to cisplatin and radiotherapy, and responses to bioactive compounds are also evaluated. Most reported axes are supported primarily by cell-line experiments, whereas absolute RNA quantification is frequently unavailable and patient-level validation remains limited. Accordingly, ceRNA networks represent potential biomarkers and therapeutic targets, although additional mechanistic and clinical evidence is required to establish their clinical applicability.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述探讨了竞争性内源 RNA (ceRNA) 网络在 宫颈癌 (CC) 中的作用,重点关注其机制和临床意义。CC的主要病因是高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HR-HPV)的持续感染。该综述旨在将 ceRNA 轴分类为致癌轴或肿瘤抑制轴,并检查它们在关键信号通路上的收敛性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对 HPV 相关疾病中 ceRNA 网络的系统分析,特别是 宫颈癌。它包括对长非编码 RNA (lncRNA)、环状 RNA (circRNA) 和假基因(如 ceRNA)的作用的研究。该综述评估了这些网络与主要信号通路及其对预后和 治疗 耐药性的影响相关的证据。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,ceRNA 网络参与了 宫颈癌 中 Wnt/β-catenin、PI3K/Akt、MAPK、Hippo 和 Notch 等关键信号通路的调节。这些网络被归类为致癌网络或肿瘤抑制网络,它们在疾病进展和 治疗 耐药性中的作用得到了强调。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该评论指出,大多数报道的 ceRNA 轴主要由细胞系实验支持,患者水平的验证有限。绝对 RNA 定量通常无法实现,这可能会影响研究结果的可靠性。此外,这些网络作为生物标志物或治疗靶点的临床适用性仍有待确定。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,需要进一步的机制和临床研究来验证 ceRNA 网络在 宫颈癌 中的作用。这包括患者水平验证、绝对 RNA 定量以及探索其作为生物标志物或治疗靶点的潜力。

papers.abstract_zh: 宫颈癌 (CC) 仍然是女性癌症相关 死亡率 的主要原因,高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HR-HPV) 的持续感染是其主要病因。长非编码 RNA (lncRNA)、环状 RNA (circRNA) 和假基因可以通过与信使 RNA (mRNA) 竞争与 microRNA (miRNA) 的结合,充当竞争性内源 RNA (ceRNA),从而减少 miRNA 介导的靶 mRNA 抑制。本综述将 CC 中报道的 ceRNA 轴分类为致癌轴或肿瘤抑制轴,并检查了它们在主要信号通路上的收敛性,包括 Wnt/β-连环蛋白、磷酸肌醇 3-激酶 (PI3K)/Akt、丝裂原激活蛋白激酶 (MAPK)、Hippo 和 Notch,以及支持证据的强度。还评估了这些网络在预后、顺铂和放疗耐药性以及对生物活性化合物的反应中的作用。大多数报告的轴主要由细胞系实验支持,而绝对 RNA 定量通常无法实现,并且患者水平的验证仍然有限。因此,ceRNA 网络代表了潜在的生物标志物和治疗靶点,尽管需要额外的机制和临床证据来确定其临床适用性。

analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该评论指出,大多数报道的 ceRNA 轴主要由细胞系实验支持,患者水平的验证有限。绝对 RNA 定量通常无法实现,这可能会影响研究结果的可靠性。此外,这些网络作为生物标志物或治疗靶点的临床适用性仍有待确定。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,需要进一步的机制和临床研究来验证 ceRNA 网络在 宫颈癌 中的作用。这包括患者水平验证、绝对 RNA 定量以及探索其作为生物标志物或治疗靶点的潜力。

papers.title: Global, regional and national burden of cervical cancer in 1990-2023 with forecasts to 2050: a Global Burden of Disease study.
papers.abstract: Although highly preventable, cervical cancer remains one of the most common malignancies among women worldwide. As part of the Global Burden of Disease study, we estimated cervical cancer incidence, mortality and disability-adjusted life-years (DALYs) across 204 countries and territories from 1990 to 2023, with forecasts to 2050. In 2023, 887,000 new cases (95% uncertainty interval 682,000-1,170,000), 369,000 deaths (292,000-475,000) and 13.3 million DALYs (10.1-17.4) were estimated globally. Age-standardized incidence rate (ASIR) and age-standardized mortality rates (ASMR) were more than four and seven times higher in low- versus high-income countries. Between 1990 and 2023, global ASIR was largely stable (-0.4% (-26.6 to 34.7)), whereas ASMR changed by -17.5% (-36.2 to 13.4). All cervical cancer DALYs were attributable to human papillomavirus infection, with tobacco use contributing 5.9% (3.2-9.3) globally. By 2050, global ASIR and ASMR are forecast to change by -12.5% (-25.7 to 3.5) and -9.0% (-21.5 to 6.6) from 2024, yet absolute cases and deaths are forecast to rise by 20.2% (4.6-38.5) and 39.3% (23.6-57.3). ASIR and ASMR are forecast to remain highest in low-income countries. Intensified action is needed to accelerate progress.

analysis.methods: The study used a comprehensive approach to estimate cervical cancer burden, including data collection from multiple sources and statistical modeling to forecast trends up to 2050.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the burden of cervical cancer is largely stable in terms of incidence but has decreased in mortality, with all DALYs attributable to human papillomavirus infection.

analysis.summary_en: This study estimates the global, regional and national burden of cervical cancer from 1990 to 2023, with forecasts to 2050. It highlights that cervical cancer remains a significant public health issue, with higher incidence and mortality rates in low-income countries. The study finds that all cervical cancer DALYs are attributable to human papillomavirus infection, with tobacco use contributing a small proportion. While global incidence and mortality rates have remained largely stable, forecasts suggest an increase in absolute cases and deaths by 2050. The study emphasizes the need for intensified action to reduce the burden of cervical cancer, particularly in low-income regions. The evidence is considered moderate due to the reliance on aggregated data and forecasting methods.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要加强行动来解决 宫颈癌,特别是在负担仍然最高的低收入国家。

papers.title: TWIST family in cervical cancer biology: From molecular mechanisms to clinical implications.
papers.abstract: Despite ongoing clinical efforts, cervical cancer remains one of the most common gynecologic tumors, largely due to its metastatic potential and resistance to chemotherapy. The transcriptional regulator TWIST has been implicated in these features, in part through the induction of epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT). The expression of TWIST is delicately regulated by several exogenous factors, including hypoxia-driven HIF-1α signaling and TGF-β pathways, as well as endogenous oncogenic cascades such as Wnt/β-catenin, NF-κB, PI3K/Akt, Hedgehog, Notch, and IL-6/JAK2/STAT3. Moreover, the E6 and E7 proteins from high-risk human papillomavirus strains promote TWIST upregulation, facilitating cellular plasticity and evasion of senescence. Post-transcriptional and epigenetic regulation is orchestrated by complex networks of non-coding RNAs and key transcription factors such as Mist1, FOXC1, and LMX-1A. Importantly, hypermethylation of the TWIST1 promoter has been proposed as a candidate biomarker for cervical intraepithelial neoplasia. TWIST has been reported to promote tumor-associated phenotypes through E-cadherin downregulation, induction of matrix metalloproteinases, and maintenance of stem cell-like properties. TWIST has been associated with chemotherapy and radiotherapy resistance, potentially through mechanisms involving DNA-damage responses and MDR1/P-glycoprotein-mediated drug efflux. The tumor microenvironment affects its expression and activity, including hypoxia, cancer-associated fibroblasts, inflammatory cytokines, tumor-associated macrophages, and extracellular vesicles. In a clinical context, high levels of TWIST are linked to poor outcomes in cervical cancer. Growing evidence links it to immune evasion through regulation of PD-L1, immunosuppressive cytokine signaling, macrophage polarization, T-cell exclusion, and immune resistance associated with cancer stem cells, underscoring its importance for translation in the current era of immune checkpoint blockade.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the role of the TWIST family in cervical cancer biology, particularly its involvement in metastatic potential, chemotherapy resistance, and immune evasion. The central question is how TWIST contributes to these features through molecular mechanisms such as EMT, oncogenic pathways, and interactions with the tumor microenvironment.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of existing literature, with no explicit mention of systematic search methods, databases, or meta-analysis. It discusses the regulation of TWIST by exogenous and endogenous factors, as well as its clinical relevance in cervical cancer.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that TWIST is a key player in cervical cancer progression, promoting tumor-associated phenotypes through E-cadherin downregulation, matrix metalloproteinase induction, and stem cell-like properties. It also highlights the association of TWIST with poor clinical outcomes in cervical cancer.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that while TWIST is implicated in chemotherapy and radiotherapy resistance, the exact mechanisms remain unclear. Additionally, the role of TWIST in immune evasion and its potential as a biomarker for cervical intraepithelial neoplasia require further investigation.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that understanding TWIST regulation and its role in cervical cancer could lead to targeted therapies, improved biomarkers for early detection, and better strategies for immune checkpoint blockade in HPV-associated cancers.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the molecular mechanisms and clinical implications of the TWIST family in cervical cancer biology. It highlights the role of TWIST in promoting metastasis, chemotherapy resistance, and immune evasion through processes like EMT and interactions with oncogenic pathways. The review also discusses its regulation by factors such as hypoxia, TGF-β, and HPV proteins, and its potential as a biomarker for cervical intraepithelial neoplasia. Despite these insights, the exact mechanisms of TWIST-mediated resistance and immune evasion remain unresolved, underscoring the need for further research to inform therapeutic strategies and improve patient outcomes.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注 TWIST 家族在 宫颈癌 生物学中的作用,特别是其在转移潜力、化疗耐药和免疫逃避方面的作用。核心问题是 TWIST 如何通过 EMT、致癌途径以及与肿瘤微环境的相互作用等分子机制来实现这些特征。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对现有文献的叙述性综合,没有明确提及系统搜索方法、数据库或荟萃分析。它讨论了外源性和内源性因素对 TWIST 的调节及其在 宫颈癌 中的临床相关性。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述的结论是,TWIST 是 宫颈癌 进展的关键参与者,通过 E-钙粘蛋白下调、基质金属蛋白酶诱导和干细胞样特性促进肿瘤相关表型。它还强调了 TWIST 与 宫颈癌 不良临床结果的关联。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该评论指出,虽然 TWIST 与化疗和放疗耐药有关,但确切的机制仍不清楚。此外,TWIST 在免疫逃避中的作用及其作为宫颈上皮内瘤变生物标志物的潜力需要进一步研究。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,了解 TWIST 调节及其在 宫颈癌 中的作用可能会导致靶向治疗、改进早期检测的生物标志物以及针对 HPV 相关癌症的免疫检查点阻断的更好策略。

papers.abstract_zh: 尽管临床不断努力,宫颈癌 仍然是最常见的妇科肿瘤之一,这主要是由于其转移潜力和对化疗的耐药性。转录调节因子 TWIST 与这些特征有关,部分是通过诱导上皮间质转化 (EMT) 来实现的。TWIST 的表达受到多种外源因子的精细调节,包括缺氧驱动的 HIF-1α 信号传导和 TGF-β 通路,以及内源性致癌级联,例如 Wnt/β-catenin、NF-κB、PI3K/Akt、Hedgehog、Notch 和 IL-6/JAK2/STAT3。此外,来自高风险 人乳头瘤病毒 菌株的 E6 和 E7 蛋白促进 TWIST 上调,促进细胞可塑性和逃避衰老。转录后和表观遗传调控是由非编码 RNA 和关键转录因子(例如 Mist1、FOXC1 和 LMX-1A)组成的复杂网络精心策划的。重要的是,TWIST1 启动子的高甲基化已被提议作为宫颈上皮内瘤变的候选生物标志物。据报道,TWIST 通过下调 E-钙粘蛋白、诱导基质金属蛋白酶和维持干细胞样特性来促进肿瘤相关表型。TWIST 可能通过涉及 DNA 损伤反应和 MDR1/P-糖蛋白介导的药物流出的机制与化疗和放疗耐药性相关。肿瘤微环境影响其表达和活性,包括缺氧、癌症相关成纤维细胞、炎症细胞因子、肿瘤相关巨噬细胞和细胞外囊泡。在临床背景下,高水平的 TWIST 与 宫颈癌 的不良结果相关。越来越多的证据表明,它通过调节 PD-L1、免疫抑制性细胞因子信号传导、巨噬细胞极化、T 细胞排斥以及与癌症干细胞相关的免疫抵抗来逃避免疫,强调了它在当前免疫检查点封锁时代的翻译重要性。

papers.title: Treatment-associated changes in the cervicovaginal microbiome and microbial correlates of HPV clearance and cervical disease outcomes: a systematic review
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Treatment for high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV), cervical intraepithelial neoplasia, and cervical cancer is effective, but HPV may persist or recur. We synthesised evidence on post-treatment cervicovaginal microbiota (CVM) changes and pre-treatment CVM correlates of outcomes. Methods Five databases were searched to August 20, 2026 for studies assessing the CVM molecularly before, or before and after, treatment. Risk of bias was assessed using RoB-2, ROBINS-I, and the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale. Findings were synthesised narratively under Synthesis Without Meta-analysis guidance and stratified by population, treatment, sampling site, and outcome. analysis.summary_en: This systematic review examines treatment-associated changes in the cervicovaginal microbiome and microbial correlates of HPV clearance and cervical disease outcomes. Twenty-one studies were included, with most reporting lower alpha diversity and increased Lactobacillus dominance post-treatment. elements_zh.scope_and_question: 治疗 宫颈阴道微生物组的相关变化以及 HPV 清除率和宫颈疾病结果的微生物相关性:系统评价。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 截至 2026 年 8 月 20 日,我们检索了五个数据库,以评估 治疗 之前、之前和之后的子宫颈阴道微生物组 (CVM) 分子水平。使用 RoB-2、ROBINS-I 和纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表评估偏倚风险。研究结果在无荟萃分析的综合指导下进行叙述性综合,并按人群、治疗、采样地点和结果进行分层。没有进行荟萃分析和正式的发表偏倚评估。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 纳入 21 项研究:16 项 队列研究、三项非随机研究和两项随机试验。大多数切除或益生菌研究报告称,治疗 后,α 多样性较低,乳酸菌优势较大;一项研究显示,在切除环后,清除 HR-HPV 的女性中,乳酸菌耗尽的群体从 32% 下降到 10%。基线惰性乳杆菌随着 HPV 持续存在而升高(62% vs 16%;60% vs 45%)。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 个别研究将几种厌氧菌类群与 HPV 持续存在或复发联系起来,并将干酪乳杆菌、厌氧消化链球菌和乳酸厌氧球菌与清除联系起来,但这些关联均未经过外部验证,并且多重测试校正的报告也不一致。只有五项研究包括对照组。11 项研究中有 8 项发现基线 α 多样性的结果没有差异。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 基线惰性乳杆菌优势是需要前瞻性确认的不利结果的候选相关性。该综述强调需要进一步研究来验证 HPV 清除率和宫颈疾病结果之间的微生物相关性,并探索微生物组变化与 HPV 持续存在或复发之间的因果关系。

Conclusions After treatment, the CVM often shifts towards lower-diversity, Lactobacillus-dominant communities, but causality is unproven. iners dominance is a candidate correlate of unfavourable outcomes requiring prospective confirmation.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 治疗 宫颈阴道微生物组的相关变化以及 HPV 清除率和宫颈疾病结果的微生物相关性:系统评价。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 截至 2026 年 8 月 20 日,我们检索了五个数据库,以评估 治疗 之前、之前和之后的子宫颈阴道微生物组 (CVM) 分子水平。使用 RoB-2、ROBINS-I 和纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表评估偏倚风险。研究结果在无荟萃分析的综合指导下进行叙述性综合,并按人群、治疗、采样地点和结果进行分层。没有进行荟萃分析和正式的发表偏倚评估。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 纳入 21 项研究:16 项 队列研究、三项非随机研究和两项随机试验。大多数切除或益生菌研究报告称,治疗 后,α 多样性较低,乳酸菌优势较大;一项研究显示,在切除环后,清除 HR-HPV 的女性中,乳酸菌耗尽的群体从 32% 下降到 10%。基线惰性乳杆菌随着 HPV 持续存在而升高(62% vs 16%;60% vs 45%)。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 个别研究将几种厌氧菌类群与 HPV 持续存在或复发联系起来,并将干酪乳杆菌、厌氧消化链球菌和乳酸厌氧球菌与清除联系起来,但这些关联均未经过外部验证,并且多重测试校正的报告也不一致。只有五项研究包括对照组。11 项研究中有 8 项发现基线 α 多样性的结果没有差异。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 基线惰性乳杆菌优势是需要前瞻性确认的不利结果的候选相关性。该综述强调需要进一步研究来验证 HPV 清除率和宫颈疾病结果之间的微生物相关性,并探索微生物组变化与 HPV 持续存在或复发之间的因果关系。

订阅BioHot点这里解锁原文链接推送! “畅读会员”点此登录查看原文链接 Open access 背景:人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)是孟加拉国宫颈癌(CC)的主要致病因素。本研究调查了孟加拉国宫颈异常女性中HPV的发生率、流行基因型及其系统发育关系,并对一株来自孟加拉国的HPV45毒株进行了全基因组、谱系及突变特征分析。 方法:在孟加拉国一家三级医院采集了102名宫颈异常女性的宫颈拭子。采用基因特异性引物通过PCR扩增检测HPV。在HPV阳性样本中,选择PCR条带强度高的样本进行L1基因部分片段的Sanger测序。代表性HPV45毒株的全基因组测序在Illumina NovaSeq X Plus平台上完成。系统发育分析使用MAFFT、IQ-TREE2和RAxML-NG软件进行。突变、结构及蛋白稳定性分析采用生物信息学和结构建模工具完成。 结果:在102名参与者中检出HPV DNA阳性率为47.1%(48/102)。在基于强PCR条带强度选出的36份测序样本中,21份成功获得序列。测序毒株的基因分型显示高危型HPV基因型占优势(95.45%),其中HPV16(68.18%)和HPV18(13.63%)最为常见。系统发育分析显示基因型特异性聚类,且与全球流行毒株具有密切的遗传亲缘关系。一株HPV45毒株(HPV_MGH-TT01)的完整基因组特征分析显示其基因组长度为7,849 bp,属于A2亚谱系,与全球参考毒株的核苷酸一致性为98.0%–99.9%。研究鉴定出多个氨基酸替换,主要集中于E2蛋白,但结构分析预测仅引起微小的构象改变。 结论:高危型HPV基因型的优势分布以及HPV45的基因组特征分析,凸显了开展大规模基因组监测和扩大分子筛查对于预防孟加拉国宫颈癌的重要性。 论文解读 下载【肥胖症和糖尿病明星治疗靶点】,获取相关药物开发的最新进展。领 取 一、研究背景与意义 人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染是全球范围内最常见的性传播病毒感染之一,构成重大公共卫生负担。大多数HPV感染为一过性,可被机体免疫系统自然清除,但持续性感染与宫颈癌(CC)及其癌前病变的发生密切相关。据估计,全球约2.91亿女性感染HPV,其中约三分之一携带与宫颈癌关系最为密切的HPV16和/或HPV18。世界卫生组织(WHO)将14种HPV基因型(HPV16、18、31、33、35、39、45、51、52、56、58、59、66和68)列为与宫颈癌相关的高危型(hrHPV),而低危型(lrHPV)如HPV6、11和43则主要与良性增生性病变相关。在全球范围内,HPV16和HPV18约导致70%的宫颈癌病例。 南亚地区(包括孟加拉国)承担了全球近三分之一的宫颈癌负担。在孟加拉国,宫颈癌是女性第二大常见恶性肿瘤,约占女性癌症总数的12%,2018年新发病例约8,268例,死亡约5,214例。然而,孟加拉国缺乏全面的人群癌症登记系统,且仅有12%的女性了解宫颈癌筛查,早婚等根深蒂固的社会文化习俗进一步加重了该国的宫颈癌负担。尽管孟加拉国已在近600个VIA和临床乳腺检查(CBE)中心实施了全国免费的基于醋酸肉眼观察(VIA)的宫颈筛查项目,但VIA的有效性受限于其特异性不足和对操作者经验的依赖。在此背景下,HPV DNA检测完全符合WHO的建议,即使终身进行一次筛查也能显著降低宫颈癌的发病率和死亡率。然而,孟加拉国HPV筛查实施有限,导致HPV流行率和基因型分布的流行病学数据存在巨大缺口。此外,该国现有研究多局限于HPV基因分型,缺乏对流行HPV毒株的全基因组、进化和结构特征分析。因此,本研究旨在阐明孟加拉国一家三级医院就诊的不同宫颈异常女性中HPV感染频率、流行基因型及其系统发育关系,并对代表性HPV45毒株进行全基因组特征、谱系分析和突变谱分析,以更好地了解孟加拉国HPV的分子流行病学和遗传多样性。 二、主要技术方法 研究人员从孟加拉国达卡国家癌症研究与医院(NICRH)连续收集了2025年7月至12月期间就诊的102名宫颈异常女性的宫颈拭子样本,参与者来自孟加拉国22个地区。研究采用L1基因通用引物MY09/MY11进行PCR扩增检测HPV DNA;对PCR条带强度高的样本进行L1基因部分片段的Sanger测序以确定基因型;对代表性HPV45毒株采用Illumina NovaSeq X Plus平台进行全基因组测序;利用MAFFT、IQ-TREE2和RAxML-NG等工具进行多序列比对和最大似然法(ML)系统发育分析;通过生物信息学工具和结构建模工具(如trRosetta、PyMOL、DynaMut2等)进行突变分析、蛋白理化性质预测、三维结构建模和热稳定性预测。 三、主要研究结果 (一)参与者社会人口学特征与HPV阳性率 102名女性参与者的平均年龄为44.6岁(范围22–70岁)。PCR检测显示48名参与者HPV阳性,阳性率为47.1%(95% CI:37.3%–57.2%)。HPV阳性女性的平均年龄(45.9岁)略高于阴性女性(43.5岁)。多数参与者居住在农村地区(68.6%)、目前已婚(87.3%)、具有学校水平或未接受正式教育(93.1%)、报告单一终身性伴侣(94.1%)。绝大多数参与者(89.2%)不了解HPV在宫颈癌发展中的作用。所有参与者均无HPV疫苗接种史、吸烟或饮酒史。研究队列包含五种宫颈状况:正常宫颈(n=17)、CIN I(n=11)、CIN II/III(n=7)、宫颈癌(n=41)和宫颈炎(n=26)。HPV阳性率在≥60岁女性中最高(61.54%),在30–39岁女性中最低(42.31%);18岁前首次性行为的女性HPV阳性率(49.3%)高于18岁及以上者(42.4%)。 (二)HPV基因型多样性与进化关系 在48份HPV阳性样本中,21份L1基因序列成功获得,另有一份代表性样本获得全基因组序列。基于22条L1基因序列的基因分型分析显示高危型HPV占绝对优势(95.45%,21/22),其中HPV16占68.18%(15/22)、HPV18占13.63%(3/22)、HPV33占4.55%(1/22)、HPV45占4.55%(1/22)、HPV58占4.55%(1/22),仅鉴定出1例低危型HPV61(4.55%,1/22)。基于L1基因部分序列的系统发育分析证实了所鉴定HPV毒株与对应参考毒株的基因型特异性聚类。所有HPV16毒株与美国、非洲、巴西、中国和泰国报道的毒株具有密切遗传亲缘关系;HPV18毒株与美国、日本和泰国参考毒株紧密聚类;HPV33和HPV45毒株与美国、中国、多哥、卢森堡和南非毒株相关;HPV58与中国、墨西哥和巴西毒株聚类;HPV61与多哥、卢森堡和巴西毒株聚类。属级和种级系统发育分析显示,所有22个毒株均聚类在α乳头瘤病毒属(Alphapapillomavirus)内,其中HPV16、HPV33和HPV58属于Alpha-9物种组,HPV18和HPV45属于Alpha-7物种组,HPV61属于Alpha-3物种组。 (三)HPV45毒株全基因组特征分析 代表性毒株HPV_MGH-TT01的全基因组测序显示基因组长度为7,849 bp,相对于7,858 bp的参考基因组(NC_075269.1)在长控制区(LCR)存在9 bp缺失,GC含量为39.72%。基因组包含8个开放阅读框(ORF):早期基因E6(477 bp)、E7(321 bp)、E1(1,932 bp)、E2(1,107 bp)、E4(273 bp)和E5(222 bp),以及晚期基因L1(1,611 bp)和L2(1,392 bp)。与27条参考序列的两两比对显示高度基因组保守性,核苷酸一致性范围为98.0%(多哥毒株)至99.9%(美国毒株)。基于全基因组序列的最大似然系统发育分析显示,HPV_MGH-TT01毒株聚类在A谱系中的A2亚谱系内。两两核苷酸差异分析显示,HPV_MGH-TT01与A2亚谱系参考基因组之间的差异最小,而与B1和B2亚谱系的差异较大,符合预期的亚谱系内和亚谱系间变异模式。 (四)HPV45毒株ORF突变谱分析 与NCBI参考毒株(NC_075269.1)相比,HPV_MGH-TT01毒株的8个完整ORF和LCR中鉴定出多个同义和非同义替换。在各病毒蛋白中,E2蛋白变异程度最高,鉴定出7个氨基酸替换(I146M、D153E、S227C、R263L、P271S、N330K和I368M),其次是L2(R222A、L242V、N342D和H365N)、E6(L21T、Q46E和S129N)、E4(P25A、V61L和K79N)、E5(L8V和I72L)、E7(E6A和E82D)和L1(S49N和S383G)。E1蛋白未检测到氨基酸替换。与近期美国报道的参考毒株PV418764.1相比,仅观察到极少的氨基酸变异。 (五)蛋白稳定性与构象分析 理化性质分析显示,HPV_MGH-TT01毒株编码的所有蛋白与参考毒株相比仅存在微小的定量差异。二级和三级结构建模显示其蛋白与对应参考蛋白具有高度构象相似性。E2蛋白的结构分析显示氨基酸替换位于三个主要功能区域:N端反式激活结构域(残基1–207;I146M和D153E)、无序连接区(残基227–251;S227C)和C端DNA结合结构域(残基290–368;N330K和I368M)。E6蛋白在其锌指结构域内表现出序列变异,而E7蛋白在pRb结合N端无序区和C端锌指支架中均存在替换。热力学稳定性预测显示,E4和E5是结构最稳定的蛋白,E5具有最高的预测ΔΔG稳定值(1.02 kcal/mol),而E2被预测为最不稳定的蛋白,总ΔΔG值为?2.04 kcal/mol。 四、讨论与结论 本研究的HPV检出率(47.1%)高于孟加拉国既往基于人群的研究,这可能归因于纳入了具有宫颈异常和癌前病变的女性而非一般筛查人群。HPV16和HPV18的优势分布与全球流行病学报告一致。值得注意的是,41例确诊宫颈癌病例中有15例L1 PCR阴性,7例CIN II/III中仅1例阳性,这可能反映了MY09/11检测的局限性,包括引物不匹配、病毒整合过程中L1基因破坏和DNA降解等导致的假阴性结果。系统发育分析显示孟加拉国HPV16和HPV18毒株与全球不同地理区域的毒株具有密切遗传亲缘关系,表明循环变异株具有高度序列保守性和共同进化祖先。HPV45 A2亚谱系毒株的鉴定以及各蛋白中多个氨基酸替换的发现,特别是E2蛋白的变异,可能影响病毒复制、持续性、免疫逃逸和致癌潜力,但其功能意义需要进一步的实验验证。本研究存在样本量较小、单中心招募、缺乏PCR对照、仅22/48阳性样本完成基因分型等局限性。研究结论强调,高危型HPV基因型的优势分布和HPV45的基因组特征凸显了大规模基因组监测和扩大分子筛查对于预防孟加拉国宫颈癌的重要性。 打赏 展开全文 方法:在孟加拉国一家三级医院采集了102名宫颈异常女性的宫颈拭子。采用基因特异性引物通过PCR扩增检测HPV。在HPV阳性样本中,选择PCR条带强度高的样本进行L1基因部分片段的Sanger测序。代表性HPV45毒株的全基因组测序在Illumina NovaSeq X Plus平台上完成。系统发育分析使用MAFFT、IQ-TREE2和RAxML-NG软件进行。突变、结构及蛋白稳定性分析采用生物信息学和结构建模工具完成。 结果:在102名参与者中检出HPV DNA阳性率为47.1%(48/102)。在基于强PCR条带强度选出的36份测序样本中,21份成功获得序列。测序毒株的基因分型显示高危型HPV基因型占优势(95.45%),其中HPV16(68.18%)和HPV18(13.63%)最为常见。系统发育分析显示基因型特异性聚类,且与全球流行毒株具有密切的遗传亲缘关系。一株HPV45毒株(HPV_MGH-TT01)的完整基因组特征分析显示其基因组长度为7,849 bp,属于A2亚谱系,与全球参考毒株的核苷酸一致性为98.0%–99.9%。研究鉴定出多个氨基酸替换,主要集中于E2蛋白,但结构分析预测仅引起微小的构象改变。 结论:高危型HPV基因型的优势分布以及HPV45的基因组特征分析,凸显了开展大规模基因组监测和扩大分子筛查对于预防孟加拉国宫颈癌的重要性。 论文解读 下载【肥胖症和糖尿病明星治疗靶点】,获取相关药物开发的最新进展。领 取 一、研究背景与意义 人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染是全球范围内最常见的性传播病毒感染之一,构成重大公共卫生负担。大多数HPV感染为一过性,可被机体免疫系统自然清除,但持续性感染与宫颈癌(CC)及其癌前病变的发生密切相关。据估计,全球约2.91亿女性感染HPV,其中约三分之一携带与宫颈癌关系最为密切的HPV16和/或HPV18。世界卫生组织(WHO)将14种HPV基因型(HPV16、18、31、33、35、39、45、51、52、56、58、59、66和68)列为与宫颈癌相关的高危型(hrHPV),而低危型(lrHPV)如HPV6、11和43则主要与良性增生性病变相关。在全球范围内,HPV16和HPV18约导致70%的宫颈癌病例。 南亚地区(包括孟加拉国)承担了全球近三分之一的宫颈癌负担。在孟加拉国,宫颈癌是女性第二大常见恶性肿瘤,约占女性癌症总数的12%,2018年新发病例约8,268例,死亡约5,214例。然而,孟加拉国缺乏全面的人群癌症登记系统,且仅有12%的女性了解宫颈癌筛查,早婚等根深蒂固的社会文化习俗进一步加重了该国的宫颈癌负担。尽管孟加拉国已在近600个VIA和临床乳腺检查(CBE)中心实施了全国免费的基于醋酸肉眼观察(VIA)的宫颈筛查项目,但VIA的有效性受限于其特异性不足和对操作者经验的依赖。在此背景下,HPV DNA检测完全符合WHO的建议,即使终身进行一次筛查也能显著降低宫颈癌的发病率和死亡率。然而,孟加拉国HPV筛查实施有限,导致HPV流行率和基因型分布的流行病学数据存在巨大缺口。此外,该国现有研究多局限于HPV基因分型,缺乏对流行HPV毒株的全基因组、进化和结构特征分析。因此,本研究旨在阐明孟加拉国一家三级医院就诊的不同宫颈异常女性中HPV感染频率、流行基因型及其系统发育关系,并对代表性HPV45毒株进行全基因组特征、谱系分析和突变谱分析,以更好地了解孟加拉国HPV的分子流行病学和遗传多样性。 二、主要技术方法 研究人员从孟加拉国达卡国家癌症研究与医院(NICRH)连续收集了2025年7月至12月期间就诊的102名宫颈异常女性的宫颈拭子样本,参与者来自孟加拉国22个地区。研究采用L1基因通用引物MY09/MY11进行PCR扩增检测HPV DNA;对PCR条带强度高的样本进行L1基因部分片段的Sanger测序以确定基因型;对代表性HPV45毒株采用Illumina NovaSeq X Plus平台进行全基因组测序;利用MAFFT、IQ-TREE2和RAxML-NG等工具进行多序列比对和最大似然法(ML)系统发育分析;通过生物信息学工具和结构建模工具(如trRosetta、PyMOL、DynaMut2等)进行突变分析、蛋白理化性质预测、三维结构建模和热稳定性预测。 三、主要研究结果 (一)参与者社会人口学特征与HPV阳性率 102名女性参与者的平均年龄为44.6岁(范围22–70岁)。PCR检测显示48名参与者HPV阳性,阳性率为47.1%(95% CI:37.3%–57.2%)。HPV阳性女性的平均年龄(45.9岁)略高于阴性女性(43.5岁)。多数参与者居住在农村地区(68.6%)、目前已婚(87.3%)、具有学校水平或未接受正式教育(93.1%)、报告单一终身性伴侣(94.1%)。绝大多数参与者(89.2%)不了解HPV在宫颈癌发展中的作用。所有参与者均无HPV疫苗接种史、吸烟或饮酒史。研究队列包含五种宫颈状况:正常宫颈(n=17)、CIN I(n=11)、CIN II/III(n=7)、宫颈癌(n=41)和宫颈炎(n=26)。HPV阳性率在≥60岁女性中最高(61.54%),在30–39岁女性中最低(42.31%);18岁前首次性行为的女性HPV阳性率(49.3%)高于18岁及以上者(42.4%)。 (二)HPV基因型多样性与进化关系 在48份HPV阳性样本中,21份L1基因序列成功获得,另有一份代表性样本获得全基因组序列。基于22条L1基因序列的基因分型分析显示高危型HPV占绝对优势(95.45%,21/22),其中HPV16占68.18%(15/22)、HPV18占13.63%(3/22)、HPV33占4.55%(1/22)、HPV45占4.55%(1/22)、HPV58占4.55%(1/22),仅鉴定出1例低危型HPV61(4.55%,1/22)。基于L1基因部分序列的系统发育分析证实了所鉴定HPV毒株与对应参考毒株的基因型特异性聚类。所有HPV16毒株与美国、非洲、巴西、中国和泰国报道的毒株具有密切遗传亲缘关系;HPV18毒株与美国、日本和泰国参考毒株紧密聚类;HPV33和HPV45毒株与美国、中国、多哥、卢森堡和南非毒株相关;HPV58与中国、墨西哥和巴西毒株聚类;HPV61与多哥、卢森堡和巴西毒株聚类。属级和种级系统发育分析显示,所有22个毒株均聚类在α乳头瘤病毒属(Alphapapillomavirus)内,其中HPV16、HPV33和HPV58属于Alpha-9物种组,HPV18和HPV45属于Alpha-7物种组,HPV61属于Alpha-3物种组。 (三)HPV45毒株全基因组特征分析 代表性毒株HPV_MGH-TT01的全基因组测序显示基因组长度为7,849 bp,相对于7,858 bp的参考基因组(NC_075269.1)在长控制区(LCR)存在9 bp缺失,GC含量为39.72%。基因组包含8个开放阅读框(ORF):早期基因E6(477 bp)、E7(321 bp)、E1(1,932 bp)、E2(1,107 bp)、E4(273 bp)和E5(222 bp),以及晚期基因L1(1,611 bp)和L2(1,392 bp)。与27条参考序列的两两比对显示高度基因组保守性,核苷酸一致性范围为98.0%(多哥毒株)至99.9%(美国毒株)。基于全基因组序列的最大似然系统发育分析显示,HPV_MGH-TT01毒株聚类在A谱系中的A2亚谱系内。两两核苷酸差异分析显示,HPV_MGH-TT01与A2亚谱系参考基因组之间的差异最小,而与B1和B2亚谱系的差异较大,符合预期的亚谱系内和亚谱系间变异模式。 (四)HPV45毒株ORF突变谱分析 与NCBI参考毒株(NC_075269.1)相比,HPV_MGH-TT01毒株的8个完整ORF和LCR中鉴定出多个同义和非同义替换。在各病毒蛋白中,E2蛋白变异程度最高,鉴定出7个氨基酸替换(I146M、D153E、S227C、R263L、P271S、N330K和I368M),其次是L2(R222A、L242V、N342D和H365N)、E6(L21T、Q46E和S129N)、E4(P25A、V61L和K79N)、E5(L8V和I72L)、E7(E6A和E82D)和L1(S49N和S383G)。E1蛋白未检测到氨基酸替换。与近期美国报道的参考毒株PV418764.1相比,仅观察到极少的氨基酸变异。 (五)蛋白稳定性与构象分析 理化性质分析显示,HPV_MGH-TT01毒株编码的所有蛋白与参考毒株相比仅存在微小的定量差异。二级和三级结构建模显示其蛋白与对应参考蛋白具有高度构象相似性。E2蛋白的结构分析显示氨基酸替换位于三个主要功能区域:N端反式激活结构域(残基1–207;I146M和D153E)、无序连接区(残基227–251;S227C)和C端DNA结合结构域(残基290–368;N330K和I368M)。E6蛋白在其锌指结构域内表现出序列变异,而E7蛋白在pRb结合N端无序区和C端锌指支架中均存在替换。热力学稳定性预测显示,E4和E5是结构最稳定的蛋白,E5具有最高的预测ΔΔG稳定值(1.02 kcal/mol),而E2被预测为最不稳定的蛋白,总ΔΔG值为?2.04 kcal/mol。 四、讨论与结论 本研究的HPV检出率(47.1%)高于孟加拉国既往基于人群的研究,这可能归因于纳入了具有宫颈异常和癌前病变的女性而非一般筛查人群。HPV16和HPV18的优势分布与全球流行病学报告一致。值得注意的是,41例确诊宫颈癌病例中有15例L1 PCR阴性,7例CIN II/III中仅1例阳性,这可能反映了MY09/11检测的局限性,包括引物不匹配、病毒整合过程中L1基因破坏和DNA降解等导致的假阴性结果。系统发育分析显示孟加拉国HPV16和HPV18毒株与全球不同地理区域的毒株具有密切遗传亲缘关系,表明循环变异株具有高度序列保守性和共同进化祖先。HPV45 A2亚谱系毒株的鉴定以及各蛋白中多个氨基酸替换的发现,特别是E2蛋白的变异,可能影响病毒复制、持续性、免疫逃逸和致癌潜力,但其功能意义需要进一步的实验验证。本研究存在样本量较小、单中心招募、缺乏PCR对照、仅22/48阳性样本完成基因分型等局限性。研究结论强调,高危型HPV基因型的优势分布和HPV45的基因组特征凸显了大规模基因组监测和扩大分子筛查对于预防孟加拉国宫颈癌的重要性。 打赏 展开全文 source_language_evidence.scale_impact_and_risk: (二)HPV基因型多样性与进化关系 在48份HPV阳性样本中,21份L1基因序列成功获得,另有一份代表性样本获得全基因组序列。基于22条L1基因序列的基因分型分析显示高危型HPV占绝对优势(95.45%,21/22),其中HPV16占68.18%(15/22)、HPV18占13.63%(3/22)、HPV33占4.55%(1/22)、HPV45占4.55%(1/22)、HPV58占4.55%(1/22),仅鉴定出1例低危型HPV61(4.55%,1/22)。基于L1基因部分序列的系统发育分析证实了所鉴定HPV毒株与对应参考毒株的基因型特异性聚类。所有HPV16毒株与美国、非洲、巴西、中国和泰国报道的毒株具有密切遗传亲缘关系;HPV18毒株与美国、日本和泰国参考毒株紧密聚类;HPV33和HPV45毒株与美国、中国、多哥、卢森堡和南非毒株相关;HPV58与中国、墨西哥和巴西毒株聚类;HPV61与多哥、卢森堡和巴西毒株聚类。属级和种级系统发育分析显示,所有22个毒株均聚类在α乳头瘤病毒属(Alphapapillomavirus)内,其中HPV16、HPV33和HPV58属于Alpha-9物种组,HPV18和HPV45属于Alpha-7物种组,HPV61属于Alpha-3物种组。
